title.en: Sydney reaches 33C in potentially warmest start to spring since mid-1800s, while snow forecast in southern NSW
title.zh: 悉尼春季开局或迎1850年代以来最暖天气，南部新州却预报降雪

summary.en: Sydney is bracing for its warmest spring start since the mid-1800s, with temperatures expected to reach 33C and a total fire ban in place due to extreme fire danger exacerbated by hot and windy conditions. This contrasts with forecasts of snow in southern New South Wales, highlighting unusual weather patterns across...
summary.zh: 悉尼正准备迎接自19世纪中叶以来最温暖的春季开端，气温预计将达到33摄氏度，并因炎热多风的天气加剧了极端火灾危险，已实施全面禁火令。这与新南威尔士州南部预测的降雪形成鲜明对比，凸显了澳大利亚东部不同寻常的天气模式。

body.en: A total fire ban is in place for greater Sydney with extreme fire danger exacerbated by hot and windy conditions Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Summer heat is due to arrive early across much of eastern Australia with potentially record early September temperatures predicted for Brisbane and Sydney, while snow was expected in southern New South Wales. Maximum temperatures in Sydney during the first days of September were on track to match the city’s midsummer average of 26.4C, warmer than any other start to spring since the city’s Observatory Hill station opened in 1858. Continue reading...
body.zh: 大悉尼地区已实施全面禁火令，炎热多风的天气会加剧极端火灾危险 获取我们的突发新闻电子邮件、免费应用程序或每日新闻播客 澳大利亚东部大部分地区将提前迎来夏季高温，预计布里斯班和悉尼 9 月初气温可能创历史新高，而新南威尔士州南部预计将下雪。悉尼 9 月初的最高气温有望与该市仲夏平均气温 26.4 摄氏度相匹配，这是自 1858 年该市天文台山站启用以来任何其他春季开始时都温暖的温度。继续阅读...

reflection.en: As Sydney faces unprecedented early spring heat, leading to extreme fire danger, we are reminded that this Earth, with all its varied climates and seasons, is ultimately Yahweh's. The intense heat and the contrasting snow forecast across regions call us to reflect on our role as stewards of creation, tending to it with wisdom and care.
reflection.zh: 当悉尼面临前所未有的初春高温，导致极端火灾危险时，我们被提醒，这片大地及其万有，连同其多样的气候和季节，最终都属于雅伟。这种酷热以及跨区域的降雪预报，促使我们反思作为受造之物的管家，应如何以智慧和关怀来照料这片土地。

verse.textEn: The earth is Yahweh's, and everything in it, the world, and all who live in it.
verse.textZh: 地和其中所充满的，世界和住在其间的，都属雅伟。

title.en: Why did USS Lincoln turn up in Thailand looking so rusty?
title.zh: 为什么林肯号航母会锈迹斑斑地出现在泰国？

summary.en: When the USS Abraham Lincoln docked in Thailand this week, some people were quick to criticize its condition. The US aircraft carrier has been at sea for about nine months, supporting US-Israel operations. Military experts suggest that while the deployment length is unusual, the wear and tear is not.
summary.zh: 本周，当“亚伯拉罕·林肯”号航空母舰抵达泰国时，一些人对其状况提出了批评。这艘美国航空母舰已在海上服役约九个月，支持美以行动。军事专家表示，尽管部署时间不寻常，但其磨损并非如此。

body.en:
When the USS Abraham Lincoln docked in Thailand this week some people were quick to criticise the condition it was in.

The US aircraft carrier has been at sea for about nine months where it's been supporting the US-Israel war with Iran.

BBC Verify has spoken to military experts who say, although the length of its deployment is unusual, the wear and tear isn't. Jake Horton reports.
body.zh: 当亚伯拉罕·林肯号航空母舰本周停靠在泰国时，一些人很快就批评了它的状况。 这艘美国航母已经在海上航行了大约九个月，一直在支持美以与伊朗的战争。 BBC verify 采访了军事专家，他们表示，尽管其部署时间很长，但磨损情况却并不罕见。杰克·霍顿报道。

reflection.en: The USS Abraham Lincoln's nine-month deployment, enduring the rigors of the sea, prompts reflection on the nature of service. Even when outward appearances draw criticism, the commitment to duty, like any work done heartily, is a testament to dedication.
reflection.zh: “亚伯拉罕·林肯”号航空母舰为期九个月的部署，忍受着大海的严酷考验，促使我们反思服务的本质。即使外表引来批评，但对职责的奉献，如同凡事都“甘心乐意地去作”，是对投入精神的证明。

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: Lindsay Clancy murder trial has divided US on whether she's victim or criminal
title.zh: 琳赛·克兰西谋杀案审判在美国引发分歧：她是受害者还是罪犯？

summary.en: The case of Lindsay Clancy, accused of murdering her three children, has sharply divided American public opinion. Supporters view her as a victim of severe mental health struggles, while opponents argue that mental illness does not excuse such actions, sparking a national debate on motherhood, mental health, and...
summary.zh: 琳赛·克兰西（Lindsay Clancy）被指控谋杀三个孩子一案，在美国公众中引起了尖锐的分歧。支持者认为她是严重的精神健康问题的受害者，而反对者则认为精神疾病不能成为此类行为的借口，这引发了关于母性、心理健康和刑事责任的国家性辩论。

body.en:
Jodi Fournier spent 15 days at the courthouse - sitting, listening and waiting. It was a personal duty, she felt, to show support for Lindsay Clancy, the Massachusetts mother charged with murdering her three children.

Katelyn Kazmirci, from North Carolina, convinced her mother to make a detour to the courthouse in Plymouth on their way to a family funeral, intrigued by the case she had followed on TikTok.

All around them, dozens of women wearing pink rallied in support of Clancy. Not everyone felt the same and across the country, on social media and at dinner tables, Americans have been debating the case with passion.

For nearly seven weeks, the trial transfixed and divided the nation on whether Clancy was a victim or a criminal who deserved to be behind bars.

The 36-year-old nurse's defence team argued she had been suffering from postpartum psychosis when she strangled her young children and so could not be held criminally responsible. The prosecution alleged the killings were intentional and calculated.

The judge declared a mistrial on Friday after jurors - who had heard the testimony of dozens of witnesses and deliberated for 40 hours - failed to come to a uninanimous decision.

Their inability to agree mirrored the wider discourse around the trial - one that trial attendee Maryanne Drysdale, 65, saw play out within her own family.

She and her 28-year-old daughter believe Clancy needs mental health treatment, not prison, while her three adult sons, who have children of similar age to Clancy's, completely disagree.

"It's black and white for them, [Clancy] killed the kids and that's that," she said. "I brought these kids up - how can we think so differently about this?"

Fournier believes Clancy was wronged by the US health system and felt compelled, as a woman and a mother, to show up for a case that has given a spotlight to postpartum struggles.

"It only takes one person to change the narrative," she said. "This is a global issue. This isn't just Massachusetts-small-town. This is... women everywhere."

Clancy claims she experienced hallucinations and delusions before strangling her three children - five-year-old Cora, Dawson, three, and Callan, who was eight months old - and then jumping from a second-floor window, leaving her paralysed.

The court heard testimony from more than 10 expert witnesses on Clancy's mental and postpartum health during the trial.

But some of them seemed to dispute the defence's claim that postpartum psychosis - a rare post-childbirth condition characterised by mania and depression - precluded Clancy from criminal liability.

Jennifer Tufts, who treated Clancy during more than a dozen sessions over five months, testified that she had not shown signs of psychosis.

Psychiatrist Avram Mack later testified that the...
body.zh: 乔迪·福尼耶 (Jodi Fournier) 在法院度过了 15 天——坐着、倾听和等待。她认为，对林赛·克兰西（Lindsay Clancy）表示支持是她个人的责任，这位马萨诸塞州的母亲被指控谋杀了她的三个孩子。 来自北卡罗来纳州的凯特琳·卡兹米尔奇 (Katelyn Kazmirci) 说服母亲在参加家庭葬礼的途中绕道普利茅斯法院，她对 TikTok 上关注的案件很感兴趣。 在他们周围，数十名身穿粉红色衣服的妇女集会支持克兰西。并非每个人都有同样的感受，在全国范围内，在社交媒体上和餐桌上，美国人一直在热情地讨论此案。 在近七周的时间里，这场审判震惊了全国，并在克兰西是受害者还是应入狱的罪犯问题上产生了分歧。 这位36岁的护士的辩护小组辩称，她勒死年幼的孩子时患有产后精神病，因此不能承担刑事责任。检方声称这些杀戮是故意且有计划的。 陪审员听取了数十名证人的证词并商议了 40 个小时，但未能达成一致决定，周五法官宣布审判无效。 他们未能达成一致反映了围绕审判的更广泛的讨论 - 65 岁的审判参加者玛丽安·德赖斯代尔 (Maryanne Drysdale) 看到了她自己家庭中发生的事情。 她和她 28 岁的女儿认为克兰西需要心理健康治疗，而不是坐牢，而她的三个成年儿子（他们的孩子与克兰西年龄相仿）完全不同意。 “对他们来说这是黑白分明的，[克兰西]杀了孩子们，就是这样，”她说。 “我抚养这些孩子——我们怎么能对这个问题有如此不同的看法呢？” 福尼尔认为，克兰西受到了美国卫生系统的冤屈，作为一名女性和母亲，她感到有必要出面处理这起让产后斗争成为焦点的案件。 “只需要一个人就能改变叙述，”她说。 “这是一个全球性问题。这不仅仅是马萨诸塞州的小镇。这是......世界各地的女性。” 克兰西声称，她在勒死自己的三个孩子——五岁的科拉、三岁的道森和八个月大的卡兰——之前经历了幻觉和妄想，然后从二楼的窗户跳下，导致她瘫痪。 法庭在审判期间听取了10多名专家证人关于克兰西精神和产后健康状况的证词。 但其中一些人似乎对辩方的说法提出质疑，即产后精神病——一种以躁狂和抑郁为特征的罕见产后病症——使克兰西免于承担刑事责任。 詹妮弗·塔夫茨 (Jennifer Tufts) 在五个月的时间里对克兰西进行了十几次治疗，她作证说她没有表现出精神病的迹象。 精神病学家阿夫拉姆·麦克后来作证说……

reflection.en: This trial has laid bare the profound societal struggle to reconcile compassion for those battling severe mental health crises with accountability for horrific acts. The intense debate over Lindsay Clancy's case underscores the need to advocate for the vulnerable and speak for those whose voices are lost in the complexity of suffering and justice. As Isaiah...
reflection.zh: 这场审判暴露了社会在调和对饱受严重精神健康危机折磨者的同情与对可怕行为的问责之间的深刻斗争。围绕琳赛·克兰西案的激烈辩论，凸显了为弱势群体辩护、为那些在苦难与正义的复杂性中声音被淹没的人们发声的必要性。...

verse.textEn: Learn to do right; seek justice. Defend the oppressed. Take up the cause of the fatherless; plead the case of the widow.
verse.textZh: 学习行善，寻求公平，解救受欺压的；给孤儿伸冤，为寡妇辨屈。

title.en: At least two dead in blast at Bolivia military barracks
title.zh: 玻利维亚军营爆炸至少两人死亡

summary.en: At least two people have died following an explosion at a military barracks in Viacha, Bolivia. Authorities fear the death toll may rise, as the blast injured at least 81 people and left seven missing. The explosion, caused by "pyrotechnic material," also damaged dozens of homes, and further explosions are a risk.
summary.zh: 玻利维亚维亚查一处军营发生爆炸，至少两人死亡。当局担心死亡人数可能上升，爆炸已造成至少81人受伤，7人失踪。爆炸由“烟火材料”引起，还损坏了数十户房屋，并存在进一步爆炸的风险。

body.en:
At least two people have been killed after an explosion at a military barracks in Bolivia - but authorities fear the toll could be higher.

Bolivian Defence Minister Ernesto Justiniano said at least 81 people had been injured when "pyrotechnic material" detonated at the barracks, where an artillery regiment was stationed, about 14:30 local time (18:30 GMT) on Friday. Seven others remain missing.

Health official Rita Nebraska told local television between 10 and 15 people were believed to have died in the incident in Viacha, about 30km (19 miles) from La Paz, according to Reuters.

Police said dozens of homes had been damagedby the blast and that emergency workers were searching the rubble.

Nebraska said there was a risk of a further explosion and urged people to stay at least 150m from the military base.

Bolivia's President Rodrigo Paz expressed his "deepest solidarity" with the families of those who had died and had been injured.

He wrote on social media that a "thorough, technical and transparent investigation" would take place into what happened.

Police spokesman Roger Roca told news agency AFP that fireworks had been stored at the barracks and the cause of the blast remained under investigation.
body.zh: 玻利维亚一处军营发生爆炸，造成至少两人死亡，但当局担心伤亡人数可能会更高。 玻利维亚国防部长埃内斯托·贾斯蒂亚诺表示，当地时间周五 14:30 左右（格林威治标准时间 18:30），驻有炮兵团的军营发生“烟火材料”爆炸，造成至少 81 人受伤。另外七人仍然失踪。 据路透社报道，卫生官员丽塔·内布拉斯加州告诉当地电视台，据信有 10 至 15 人在维亚查事件中死亡，该事件距离拉巴斯约 30 公里（19 英里）。 警方表示，数十座房屋在爆炸中受损，紧急救援人员正在废墟中搜寻。 内布拉斯加州表示，存在进一步爆炸的风险，并敦促人们与军事基地保持至少 150m 的距离。 玻利维亚总统罗德里戈·帕斯向死伤者家属表示“最深切的声援”。 他在社交媒体上写道，将对所发生的事情进行“彻底、技术性和透明的调查”。 警方发言人罗杰·罗卡告诉法新社，军营里存放着烟花，爆炸原因仍在调查中。

reflection.en: The explosion at the Viacha military barracks, with its tragic loss of life and widespread damage, serves as a stark reminder of the destructive potential inherent in military materials. In times of such chaos and violence, we can turn to Psalm 46:9, which speaks of a divine power that can bring an end to conflict and disarm the instruments of war. May this...
reflection.zh: 玻利维亚维亚查军营发生的爆炸，造成了悲惨的生命损失和广泛的破坏，它鲜明地提醒我们军事材料所固有的破坏潜力。在如此混乱和暴力的时刻，我们可以转向诗篇46:9，它讲述了一种能够结束冲突、解除战争工具的神圣力量。愿这种力量为受影响的人们带来和平与治愈。

verse.textEn: He makes wars cease to the ends of the earth; he breaks the bow and shatters the spear.
verse.textZh: 他止息刀兵，直到地极；他折弓断枪。

title.en: The 'grave threat' that landed the Vice President of the Philippines in court
title.zh: 让菲律宾副总统登上法庭的“严重威胁”

summary.en: Philippine Vice President Sara Duterte posted bail on Saturday, a day after an arrest warrant was issued for allegedly making death threats against the country's president. She faces charges of 'grave threats' stemming from a news briefing where she claimed to have hired a hitman to kill President Ferdinand Marcos and...
summary.zh: 菲律宾副总统萨拉·杜特尔特于周六在马尼拉一家法院办理了保释手续，此前一天，针对她涉嫌对总统发出死亡威胁的逮捕令已被签发。她面临“严重威胁”的指控，源于一次深夜新闻发布会，会上她声称如果自己先遭不测，就雇佣杀手杀死总统费迪南德·马科斯及其妻子。这一威胁也是她正在进行的参议院弹劾审判的关键部分。

body.en:
Philippine Vice President Sara Duterte posted bail at a Manila courthouse on Saturday, a day after an arrest warrant was issued over her alleged death threat against the country's president.

Duterte was charged last month with "grave threats" stemming from a late-night news briefing in which she claimed to have hired a hitman to kill President Ferdinand Marcos, his wife and a congressman cousin should she be cut down first.

The alleged assassination threat also forms a crucial element of her ongoing Senate impeachment trial, where a guilty verdict would see her removed from office and permanently banned from politics.

"The vice president voluntarily appeared before the court that issued the warrant, so there was no need for her to be arrested," her lawyer Lawrence Lim said after Duterte emerged from the regional courthouse holding a court order confirming she had posted a cash bond.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"I don't want to (post bail) if no one is watching," she said, claiming to be the victim of police harassment.

"Will they throw me into the (jail) and then one night I die in my sleep?" she said.

Under the Philippine legal code, a criminal conviction on the "grave threats" charge would carry a jail term of up to six months.

The vice president's legal team issued a statement on Friday saying she had "no intention of evading the law and will continue to exercise all her legal remedies".

Justice department officials have rejected her lawyers' argument that she cannot be prosecuted for offences that are also tied to her impeachment.

Duterte was impeached in May by the House of Representatives, the lower chamber of parliament, on charges that also included graft and corruption.

A guilty verdict in the Senate — where her trial recently concluded its ninth week — would spell an end to a planned run for president in 2028.

body.zh: 菲律宾副总统萨拉·杜特尔特周六在马尼拉法院获得保释，一天前，她因涉嫌对该国总统发出死亡威胁而发出逮捕令。 杜特尔特上个月在一次深夜新闻发布会上被指控“严重威胁”，她在新闻发布会上声称，如果她先被砍倒，她将雇佣一名杀手杀死费迪南德·马科斯总统、他的妻子和一名国会议员表弟。 所谓的暗杀威胁也是她正在进行的参议院弹劾审判的一个关键因素，如果有罪判决，她将被免职并永久禁止从政。 在杜特尔特从地区法院出来时，她拿着法庭命令，确认她已缴纳了现金保证金，她的律师劳伦斯·林(Lawrence Lim)表示，“副总统自愿出现在发出逮捕令的法院，因此没有必要逮捕她。” 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 “如果没有人在场，我不想（保释），”她说，并声称自己是警察骚扰的受害者。 “他们会把我扔进（监狱），然后有一天晚上我在睡梦中死去吗？”她说。 根据菲律宾法律，对“严重威胁”指控的刑事定罪将被判处最高六个月的监禁。 副总统的法律团队周五发表声明称，她“无意逃避法律，并将继续行使所有法律补救措施”。 司法部官员驳回了她的律师的论点，即她不能因与弹劾有关的罪行而受到起诉。 杜特尔特五月被众议院（议会下议院）弹劾，指控还包括贪污和腐败。 参议院对她的审判最近结束了第九周，如果参议院做出有罪判决，她的 2028 年总统竞选计划就将结束。 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

reflection.en: The news of Philippine Vice President Sara Duterte's arrest and bail highlights the serious consequences of alleged threats made by public officials. The charges of 'grave threats' and the ongoing impeachment trial underscore the importance of accountability in leadership. The prophet Micah reminds us that true leadership is defined not by power or...
reflection.zh: 菲律宾副总统萨拉·杜特尔特被捕并获得保释的消息，凸显了公职人员所作威胁的严重后果。这些“严重威胁”的指控以及正在进行的弹劾审判，都强调了领导层问责制的重要性。先知弥迦提醒我们，真正的领导力并非由权力和地位定义，而是由‘施行公平、喜爱慈爱、谦卑同行’的承诺所定义。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Beekeepers warn of Asian hornet threat and call for UK awareness campaign
title.zh: 养蜂人警告亚洲胡蜂的威胁，呼吁英国提高认识

summary.en: Beekeepers are urging the UK to launch a national awareness campaign about the Asian hornet, an invasive species that threatens food security by creating 'pollinator deserts'. The yellow-legged hornet, native to Southeast Asia, has spread across Europe since 2004, possibly aided by warmer climates.
summary.zh: 养蜂人敦促英国就亚洲胡蜂发起全国性宣传活动。这种入侵物种通过制造“授粉者沙漠”威胁粮食安全。原产于东南亚的黄腿胡蜂自2004年以来已在欧洲蔓延，可能得益于气候变暖。

body.en: Experts say invasive species are creating ‘pollinator deserts’ and could have serious impact on food security British beekeepers have called for a national awareness campaign about the impact of Asian hornets as they warned the invasive species was creating “pollinator deserts” and threatening food security. Native to south-east Asia, the yellow-legged hornet is thought to have arrived in Europe in 2004 and has continued to spread ever since, its numbers probably boosted by increasingly warm springs and summers. body.zh: 专家表示，入侵物种正在造成“授粉沙漠”，可能对粮食安全造成严重影响 英国养蜂人呼吁开展全国性的宣传运动，提高人们对亚洲黄蜂影响的认识，因为他们警告说，入侵物种正在造成“授粉沙漠”，并威胁粮食安全。黄腿大黄蜂原产于东南亚，据信于 2004 年抵达欧洲，此后一直在继续传播，其数量可能因日益温暖的春季和夏季而增加。继续阅读...

Proverbs 11:14 reminds us that in the multitude of counselors, there is safety, suggesting that heeding expert advice is crucial for navigating complex environmental challenges and...
reflection.zh: 养蜂人对亚洲胡蜂影响授粉和粮食安全的紧急警告，凸显了采取积极的公众意识和明智政策的必要性。《箴言》11:14 提醒我们，谋士众多，所谋乃成，这表明听取专家意见对于应对复杂的环境挑战和保障我们的未来至关重要。

verse.textEn: For lack of guidance a nation falls, but victory is won through many advisers.

title.en: Trump's peace envoys to visit Moscow and Kyiv over weekend
title.zh: 特朗普的和平使者周末将访问莫斯科和基辅

summary.en: US negotiators Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner will visit Russia and Ukraine this weekend, as efforts to end the war between the two nations appear to be gathering pace. Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelensky confirmed he will meet the envoys on Sunday after they visit Moscow on Saturday to hold talks with Russian...
summary.zh: 美国谈判代表史蒂夫·维特科夫和贾里德·库什纳本周末将访问俄罗斯和乌克兰，两国之间的战争似乎正朝着结束的方向迈进。乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基证实，在他们周六访问莫斯科与俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京举行会谈后，他将于周日会见使者。维特科夫和库什纳一直领导着美国总统唐纳德·特朗普为达成和平协议所做的努力，但双方之间仍存在分...

body.en:
US negotiators Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner will visit Russia and Ukraine this weekend, as efforts to end the war between the two nations appear to be gathering pace.

Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelensky confirmed he will meet the envoys on Sunday after they visit Moscow on Saturday to hold talks with Russian President Vladimir Putin.

Witkoff and Kushner have led US President Donald Trump's efforts to broker a peace deal, but a gulf remains between the two warring sides.

"They are bringing with them a proposal to end the war," Trump told reporters when asked about the visits.

Earlier on Friday, Zelensky said a Russian drone had hit the office of Ukraine's security chief Oleksandr Poklad in Kyiv. Poklad appears to be unharmed.

The Ukrainian leader wrote on social media that he had ordered Poklad, who heads the SBU security service, to respond "adequately" to the attack.

On Saturday, regional authorities said four people had been killed in a Russian strike on the south-eastern city of Kamianske.

Oleksandr Ganzha, head of the Dnipropetrovsk regional military administration, said five others had been wounded.

Witkoff and Kushner, Trump's son-in-law, have visited Russia multiple times, but the purported talks will be the first in Ukraine.

Zelensky said he would guarantee the safety of Russian airspace during the envoys' visit and called for Russia to do the same for Ukraine.

Russia's state news agency Tass said Witkoff and Kushner were "expected to arrive in Moscow and then to Kyiv... on 5-6 September", quoting an unnamed source.

Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov later told reporters: "I wouldn't announce anything, but when these contacts take place, we will inform you."

Meanwhile, Putin told an international economic forum on Thursday that "there are chances" a peace deal could be reached.

But he showed no sign of backing down from his maximalist demands, which included more territorial concessions from Ukraine.

Kyiv and its European allies have repeatedly rejected Putin's terms, saying they are tantamount to capitulation.

Russia launched a full-scale invasion of Ukraine in February 2022 and currently controls about 20% of its territory.
body.zh: 美国谈判代表史蒂夫·威特科夫和贾里德·库什纳将于本周末访问俄罗斯和乌克兰，结束两国之间战争的努力似乎正在加快步伐。 乌克兰总统泽连斯基证实，特使们周六访问莫斯科与俄罗斯总统普京举行会谈后，他将于周日会见他们。 威特科夫和库什纳领导了美国总统唐纳德·特朗普促成和平协议的努力，但交战双方之间仍然存在鸿沟。 当被问及此次访问时，特朗普告诉记者：“他们带来了结束战争的提议。” 周五早些时候，泽伦斯基表示，一架俄罗斯无人机袭击了乌克兰安全部长亚历山大·波克拉德位于基辅的办公室。波克拉德似乎没有受伤。 这位乌克兰领导人在社交媒体上写道，他已命令 SBU 安全部门负责人波克拉德对此次袭击做出“充分”反应。 周六，地区当局表示，俄罗斯对东南部城市卡缅斯科的袭击造成四人死亡。 第聂伯罗彼得罗夫斯克地区军事管理局局长亚历山大·甘扎（Oleksandr Ganzha）表示，另有五人受伤。 威特科夫和特朗普的女婿库什纳曾多次访问俄罗斯，但据称此次会谈将是首次在乌克兰举行。 泽连斯基表示，他将在特使访问期间保证俄罗斯领空的安全，并呼吁俄罗斯也为乌克兰做同样的事情。 俄罗斯国家通讯社塔斯社援引一位不愿透露姓名的消息人士的话称，维特科夫和库什纳“预计将于 9 月 5 日至 6 日抵达莫斯科，然后抵达基辅”。 克里姆林宫发言人德米特里·佩斯科夫后来告诉记者：“我不会宣布任何事情，但当这些接触发生时，我们会通知你们。” 与此同时，普京周四在一个国际经济论坛上表示，“有机会”达成和平协议。 但他没有表现出放弃其最高要求的迹象，其中包括乌克兰做出更多领土让步。 基辅及其欧洲盟友一再拒绝普京的条件，称这些条件无异于投降。 俄罗斯于2022年2月对乌克兰发动全面入侵，目前控制着乌克兰约20%的领土。

reflection.en: As US envoys travel to Moscow and Kyiv, carrying proposals to end the conflict, we are reminded of the difficult and often stalled work of peacemaking. The pursuit of peace requires persistent dialogue and a willingness to bridge divides, even when a gulf remains between the parties.
reflection.zh: 随着美国使者携带结束冲突的提议前往莫斯科和基辅，我们被提醒和平建设工作是艰难且常常停滞不前的。追求和平需要持续的对话和弥合分歧的意愿，即使双方之间仍存在巨大的鸿沟。

verse.textEn: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called children of God.
verse.textZh: 使人和睦的人有福了，因为他们必称为神的儿子。

title.en: Is Russia proving better at protecting friends than fighting enemies in West Africa?
title.zh: 俄罗斯在西非是保护朋友还是对抗敌人更胜一筹？

summary.en: Russian forces were brought in to help defeat jihadists but they also defend the military leadership in Niger. Following fighting in Niamey, Russia's Africa Corps assisted Nigerien loyalist forces in regaining control of a key military base.
summary.zh: 俄罗斯军队被引入以帮助击败圣战分子，但他们也保卫着尼日尔的军事领导层。在尼亚美发生战斗后，俄罗斯的非洲军团协助尼日尔忠诚部队重新控制了一个关键军事基地。

body.en:
When mutinous soldiers seized a strategic military base in Niger's capital last Saturday, the country's ruling junta turned to a foreign partner it has increasingly relied on since coming to power: Russia.

Following a night of intense fighting in Niamey, Russia's Africa Corps helped Nigerien loyalist forces to regain control of Air Base 101 at Diori Hamani International Airport.

Africa Corps, unlike its predecessor the Wagner Group, is directly under the control of the defence ministry in Moscow. It provides combat support and military training and is thought to have some 200 to 300 men in Niger.

Russia's ambassador to Niger, Viktor Voropaev, publicly acknowledged the weekend intervention, saying his country's forces had helped "repress a mutiny".

"This is seen as a symbolic victory," according to Beverly Ochieng, senior analyst at Control Risks. "[One] that will continue to put them at the centre of not just the counter-insurgency campaign, but even in the protection and prolongation of military rule."

The attempted coup offers perhaps the clearest evidence yet that Africa Corps' role in three Sahel countries extends beyond its stated mission of helping governments fight jihadist insurgencies.

Russia is increasingly demonstrating that it can provide something perhaps even more valuable to the military rulers of Niger, Mali and Burkina Faso: protection for the governments themselves.

"It was not sufficient to bring stability," said Ochieng, "but it's enough to allow these military governments to have a political lifeline."

The thwarted mutiny also highlights something the ruling junta may not want to admit - just how dependent on Moscow it has become for security.

In January, Africa Corps personnel also played an important role in repelling an attack at the same airport.

"We saw videos of the jihadists walking around the airport basically completely unimpeded," said Jacob Boswall, a security analyst who tracks jihadist activity for the BBC's media monitoring service.

"Probably there is some substance to the claim that Africa Corps was able to restore power in that case [in January]. And I think, again, in this case as well, that intervention was very significant."

One of the Nigerien military's central justifications for the July 2023 coup, which saw Gen Abdourahamane Tiani seize power, was the deteriorating security situation and alleged failure of Niger's civilian authorities, under elected President Mohamed Bazoum, to tackle it.

They also blamed Western partners at the time for their inability to contain jihadist violence.

Militants linked to al-Qaeda and Islamic State have continued to launch attacks, including in the Tillabéri and Dosso regions. Some, inflicting heavy casualties on security forces.

body.zh: 上周六，当叛变士兵占领尼日尔首都的一个战略军事基地时，该国执政军政府转向了自上台以来日益依赖的外国伙伴：俄罗斯。 经过尼亚美一夜的激烈战斗后，俄罗斯非洲军团帮助尼日尔效忠部队重新控制了迪奥里哈马尼国际机场的 101 号空军基地。 非洲军团与其前身瓦格纳集团不同，直接受莫斯科国防部控制。它提供战斗支持和军事训练，据信在尼日尔有大约 200 至 300 名人员。 俄罗斯驻尼日尔大使维克多·沃罗帕耶夫公开承认周末的干预，称俄罗斯军队帮助“镇压了叛乱”。 Control Risks 高级分析师 Beverly Ochieng 表示：“这被视为一次象征性的胜利。” “[一个]将继续将他们置于反叛乱行动的中心，甚至是保护和延长军事统治的中心。” 这次未遂政变或许提供了迄今为止最明确的证据，证明非洲军团在萨赫勒三个国家的作用超出了其既定的帮助政府打击圣战叛乱的使命。 俄罗斯越来越多地表明，它可以为尼日尔、马里和布基纳法索的军事统治者提供也许更有价值的东西：为政府本身提供保护。 奥钦说：“这还不足以带来稳定，但足以让这些军政府拥有政治生命线。” 这次受挫的兵变还突显了执政军政府可能不想承认的事情——它在安全方面已经变得多么依赖莫斯科。 1月份，非洲军团人员也在同一机场击退袭击中发挥了重要作用。 为 BBC 媒体监控服务追踪圣战活动的安全分析师雅各布·博斯沃尔 (Jacob Boswall) 表示：“我们看到圣战分子在机场基本上完全畅通无阻的视频。” “在这种情况下，非洲军团能够在（一月份）恢复电力的说法可能有一定的实质内容。我认为，在这种情况下，这种干预也非常重要。” 尼日尔军方对 2023 年 7 月阿卜杜拉哈马内·蒂尼 (Abdourahamane Tiani) 将军夺权的政变的核心理由之一是安全局势不断恶化，以及据称尼日尔民政当局在当选总统穆罕默德·巴祖姆 (Mohamed Bazoum) 领导下未能解决这一问题。 他们还指责当时的西方伙伴无力遏制圣战暴力。 与基地组织和伊斯兰国有联系的武装分子继续发动袭击，包括在蒂拉贝里和多索地区。有些给安全部队造成重大伤亡。 Ochieng 描述了最新的...

reflection.en: In the complex landscape of West Africa, Russia's Africa Corps has intervened to support Nigerien loyalist forces in regaining control of a military base. This intervention, while framed as support for a partner, highlights the intricate ways nations engage in conflict zones, sometimes seeking to establish order or protect allies amidst instability.
reflection.zh: 在西非复杂的局势中，俄罗斯的非洲军团介入支持尼日尔忠诚部队重新控制了一个军事基地。这次干预，尽管被表述为支持伙伴，却凸显了各国在冲突地区互动的复杂方式，有时是在动荡中寻求建立秩序或保护盟友。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

When Katie Taylor steps into the ring on Saturday night to defend her titles and once again enthral Ireland, there will be a bittersweet tinge. After a singular career that pioneered women’s boxing, the...
summary.zh: 在克罗克公园体育场，这位爱尔兰拳击手在她的最后一场比赛前因其坚韧不拔和鼓舞人心的精神而受到赞誉。当凯蒂·泰勒周六晚上踏入拳击台卫冕她的头衔并再次令爱尔兰着迷时，会有一种苦乐参半的情绪。在她开创女子拳击运动的辉煌职业生涯之后，这位超轻量级冠军和奥运金牌得主即将退役。她已经40岁了，这将是她的最后一场比赛。

body.en: Irish boxer lauded for her tenacity and inspiration before her last fight in front of 80,000 people at Croke Park When Katie Taylor steps into the ring on Saturday night to defend her titles and once again enthral Ireland, there will be a bittersweet tinge. After a singular career that pioneered women’s boxing, the super-lightweight champion and Olympic gold medallist is bowing out. She is 40 and it is to be her final bout. “The end of an era, isn’t it?” said Trevor McMahon, her brother-in-law and founder of a gym where she trains. “It’ll be an amazing night but it’ll also be a little bit sad. Everything she did, it might not ever be achieved again.” Continue reading...
body.zh: 爱尔兰拳击手在克罗克公园面对 80,000 名观众进行最后一场比赛之前，因其坚韧和灵感而受到称赞。当凯蒂·泰勒于周六晚上踏上拳台卫冕并再次让爱尔兰着迷时，将会有一种苦乐参半的感觉。在开创了女子拳击运动的非凡职业生涯之后，这位超轻量级冠军和奥运会金牌得主即将退出。她已经40岁了，这将是她的最后一场比赛。 “一个时代的终结，不是吗？”她的姐夫、她训练的健身房的创始人特雷弗·麦克马洪 (Trevor McMahon) 说道。 “这将是一个美妙的夜晚，但也会有点悲伤。她所做的一切，可能永远不会再实现了。”继续阅读...

reflection.en: Katie Taylor's impending final bout marks the end of a remarkable era in women's boxing. After a career defined by tenacity and inspiration, she is stepping away from the ring at 40. This transition, celebrated by 80,000 fans, reminds us that all seasons have their purpose and time, a natural rhythm of life and accomplishment.
reflection.zh: 凯蒂·泰勒即将到来的最后一场比赛标志着女子拳击界一个非凡时代的结束。在她以坚韧和鼓舞人心的精神为标志的职业生涯之后，她将在40岁时退出拳击界。这场由8万名观众庆祝的转变，提醒我们所有的季节都有其目的和时机，这是生命和成就的自然节奏。

verse.textEn: There is a time for everything, and a season for every activity under the heavens.
verse.textZh: 凡事都有定期，天下万务都有定时。

title.en: Trump downplays the conflict with Iran. Is it a sign of trouble for his presidency?
title.zh: 特朗普淡化与伊朗的冲突。这是他总统任期陷入困境的迹象吗？

summary.en: Key figures in the Trump administration are downplaying the six-month war against Iran, with President Trump calling it a "military conflict" and "small potatoes." This strategic use of language comes as midterm elections approach, prompting analysis from experts like Jared Mondschein who view it as a calculated...
summary.zh: 特朗普政府的关键人物正在淡化与伊朗长达六个月的战争，特朗普总统称之为“军事冲突”和“小事一桩”。这种策略性的语言使用正值中期选举临近之际，引发了贾里德·蒙德施恩等专家的分析，他们认为这是一种经过计算的政治举动。

body.en:
US President Donald Trump has downplayed his administration's six-month war against Iran as the midterm elections linger.

Speaking on Friday, Trump described the war as a "military conflict", saying it was "small potatoes".

"A lot of people don't call it a war. I call it a military conflict because it's small potatoes for us.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Trump's comments come a day after Vice President JD Vance said he wouldn't call the conflict "war".

United States Study Centre's director of research Jared Mondschein said Trump and Vance's choice of language was strategic.

"They're trying to distance themselves from an exceedingly unpopular action," he said.

He said not describing the conflict as "military action" instead of war minimises their investment.

"They simply want to minimise both the US commitment as well as their ties to it."

While the administration is severing its ties to the conflict, Trump said it has been a "tremendous success".

"I don't think it matters what you call it, what matters is the fact we have had a tremendous success — we've stopped Iran from having a nuclear weapon."

"The majority of Americans agree that this has driven up prices and inflation. It's driven up prices and worsened the affordability crisis," Mondschein said.

He said the US government never explained to Americans its "rationale for the war".

"The number one thing that went wrong is they over-promised and under-delivered. They also did not explain their rationale for the war, or articulate the necessity of going to war," he said.

"They did not explain their sort of metrics of success. They did not explain what it would take for them to leave, and they also did not execute a coherent plan."

Mondschein said a "sizeable percentage of Trump voters" are also losing faith in the conflict — and that it will impact "Republicans in the November midterms".

While "most midterms don't go well for the sitting president", he said this year's midterm elections are shaping up to go "exceedingly unwell" for Trump because of his dwindling popularity.

"It's pretty common for the party in power in the White House and the executive branch to lose the House of Representatives in the midterms — that happens more often than not," he explained.

"The question is the Senate, and right now the latest polling indicates that it is more likely than not that the Democrats will also take the Senate."

He said if the Democrats hold both the Senate and the House of Representatives, they can "make life exceedingly difficult for the Trump administration".

body.zh: 随着中期选举的临近，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普淡化了其政府对伊朗长达六个月的战争。 特朗普周五发表讲话，将这场战争描述为“军事冲突”，并称这是“小人物”。 “很多人不称其为战争。我称其为军事冲突，因为这对我们来说只是小事。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 特朗普发表此番言论的前一天，副总统万斯表示，他不会将这场冲突称为“战争”。 美国研究中心研究主任贾里德·蒙德沙因表示，特朗普和万斯的语言选择具有战略意义。 “他们试图与极不受欢迎的行动保持距离，”他说。 他说，不将冲突描述为“军事行动”而不是战争会最大限度地减少他们的投资。 “他们只是想尽量减少美国的承诺以及他们与美国的关系。” 尽管政府正在切断与冲突的联系，但特朗普表示这是“巨大的成功”。 “我认为你怎么称呼它并不重要，重要的是我们取得了巨大成功——我们已经阻止了伊朗拥有核武器。” “大多数美国人都认为这推高了物价和通货膨胀。它推高了价格并加剧了负担能力危机，”蒙德沙因说。 他说，美国政府从未向美国人解释其“战争的理由”。 “第一个错误是他们承诺过多而兑现不足。他们也没有解释发动战争的理由，也没有阐明发动战争的必要性，”他说。 “他们没有解释他们的成功衡量标准。他们没有解释如何才能离开，也没有执行连贯的计划。” 蒙德沙因表示，“相当大比例的特朗普选民”也对这场冲突失去了信心，并将影响“11月中期选举中的共和党人”。 虽然“大多数中期选举对现任总统来说都不太顺利”，但他表示，由于特朗普的支持率不断下降，今年的中期选举对特朗普来说将“极其不利”。 “白宫和行政部门的执政党在中期选举中失去众议院席位是很常见的——这种情况经常发生，”他解释道。 “问题在于参议院，目前最新的民意调查显示，民主党也很有可能拿下参议院。” 他表示，如果民主党同时控制参议院和众议院，他们可能“让特朗普政府的日子变得极其困难”。 蒙德沙因表示，“特朗普时代的结束是不可避免的”——他认为裂缝正在……

reflection.en: When leaders strategically reframe difficult realities, it raises questions about the counsel they receive and the truths they choose to emphasize. Proverbs 11:14 reminds us that "where there is no guidance, a people falls, but in an abundance of counselors there is safety." The careful choice of words, like calling a conflict "small potatoes," suggests a...
reflection.zh: 当领导人策略性地重新定义严峻现实时，这会引发关于他们所接受的建议以及他们选择强调的真相的问题。《箴言》11:14 提醒我们：“在没有指导的地方，人民会跌倒，但在谋士众多之处，就有安全。”诸如将冲突称为“小事一桩”之类的措辞选择，表明了管理公众看法的意图，但一个国家真正的安全在于诚实的评估和众多明智的建议。

verse.textEn: For lack of guidance a nation falls, but victory is won through many advisers.
verse.textZh: 无智谋，民就败落；谋士多，人便安居。

title.en: Australian drone team arrives in Nepal as search for missing continues
title.zh: 澳大利亚无人机团队抵达尼泊尔，搜救失踪人员仍在继续

summary.en: At least 36 Australians remain missing, with the federal government holding concerns for their welfare. Australia is sending a 15-person specialist team, including drone operators and victim identification experts, to Nepal to aid in the search and rescue efforts following catastrophic floods triggered by a glacier...
summary.zh: 至少有36名澳大利亚人仍下落不明，联邦政府对他们的福祉表示担忧。澳大利亚正派遣一个由15名专家组成的特别小组，包括无人机操作员和遇难者身份识别专家前往尼泊尔，以协助应对由冰川崩塌引发的灾难性洪水后的搜救工作。

body.en:
Australia is throwing more resources at search and rescue efforts in flood-devastated Nepal, with drone operators and victim identification experts joining the operation.

Australian rescue teams have landed in Nepal to join the search for those still missing after catastrophic floods swamped the country in August.

The 15-person specialist team landed in the capital late Friday, with additional support, including victim identification specialists on the way following a request for assistance from Nepali authorities.

A glacier collapse near Nepal's border with Tibet on 26 August triggered devastating floods across towns and valleys.

At least 36 Australians remain missing, with the federal government holding grave concerns for their welfare.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

The death toll in Nepal is nearing 1300, with almost 4800 people still missing, including 601 foreign nationals, according to official figures released on Friday.

On the Tibetan side of the border, the death toll rose to 31 on Friday, an increase of 10 since the previous tally, according to Chinese state media.

It was not clear whether they were Chinese or foreign nationals. Some 531 people were reported missing, Reuters reports.

Foreign Minister Penny Wong confirmed on Thursday that local authorities would conduct searches in areas where many Australians were believed to have been staying.

She said Australian drone operators and incident management specialists would be sent to the region as part of a broader on-the-ground support team.

"I can indicate that after our inquiries that Nepali authorities have advised us that searches are being conducted in the locations identified by Australia, including (The Kailash Hotel) and the Royal Himalaya Hotel amongst others," Senator Wong told reporters.

The Disaster Assistance Response Team consists of specialists from the Queensland Fire Department and Fire and Rescue NSW.

Fire and Rescue NSW Commissioner Jeremy Fewtrell farewelled six remotely piloted drone operators and four incident management specialists as they travelled to Nepal on Friday.

"I was proud to farewell our team this morning as they began their journey to Nepal to support communities impacted by this disaster," Fewtrell said.

"Their drones will give search and rescue teams critical information about areas that may be inaccessible or too dangerous to reach from the ground.

"They have an important job ahead of them. I wish them a safe deployment and, most importantly, a safe return home."

The drone technology has AI capabilities that can help find victims, along with thermal imaging to identify anyone trapped.

DFAT is working with local authorities to...
body.zh: 澳大利亚正在投入更多资源用于遭受洪水破坏的尼泊尔的搜救工作，无人机操作员和受害者识别专家也加入了行动。 澳大利亚救援队已抵达尼泊尔，参与八月份灾难性洪水淹没尼泊尔后仍然失踪的人员的搜寻工作。 这支由 15 人组成的专家小组于周五晚间抵达首都，并提供了额外支持，其中包括应尼泊尔当局请求援助而在途中派出的受害者识别专家。 8 月 26 日，尼泊尔与西藏边境附近的冰川崩塌引发了城镇和山谷的毁灭性洪水。 至少有 36 名澳大利亚人仍然失踪，联邦政府严重关切他们的福祉。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 根据周五公布的官方数据，尼泊尔死亡人数已接近 1300 人，仍有近 4800 人失踪，其中包括 601 名外国人。 据中国官方媒体报道，周五，西藏边境一侧的死亡人数上升至 31 人，比上次统计人数增加了 10 人。 目前尚不清楚他们是中国人还是外国人。据路透社报道，约有 531 人失踪。 外交部长黄英贤周四证实，地方当局将在据信有许多澳大利亚人居住的地区进行搜查。 她表示，澳大利亚无人机操作员和事件管理专家将被派往该地区，作为更广泛的实地支持团队的一部分。 黄参议员告诉记者：“我可以指出，经过询问，尼泊尔当局告知我们，正在澳大利亚确定的地点进行搜查，其中包括冈仁波齐酒店和皇家喜马拉雅酒店等。” 灾难援助响应小组由来自昆士兰消防局和新南威尔士州消防救援局的专家组成。 新南威尔士州消防和救援局局长杰里米·法特雷尔 (Jeremy Fewtrell) 周五在前往尼泊尔的途中与六名遥控无人机操作员和四名事件管理专家告别。 “今天早上我很自豪地告别我们的团队，他们开始前往尼泊尔支持受这场灾难影响的社区，”费特雷尔说。 “他们的无人机将为搜救队提供有关可能无法进入或太危险而无法从地面到达的区域的重要信息。 “他们面前有一项重要的工作。我祝愿他们安全部署，最重要的是，安全回家。” 无人机技术具有人工智能功能，可以帮助寻找受害者，并具有热成像功能，可以识别被困人员。 DFAT 正在与地方当局合作...

reflection.en: In the wake of devastating floods in Nepal, a specialist Australian team has arrived to search for the 36 missing citizens. This effort embodies the principle of advocating for the vulnerable, ensuring that those lost are not forgotten and that every possible measure is taken to account for their fate. It is a testament to compassion in action, reaching...
reflection.zh: 在尼泊尔发生毁灭性洪水之后，一支澳大利亚专家小组已抵达当地，搜寻36名失踪的澳大利亚公民。这项努力体现了为弱势群体发声的原则，确保那些失踪者不会被遗忘，并尽一切可能查明他们的命运。这是慈悲行动的证明，跨越国界去帮助有需要的人。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

verse.textEn: Yahweh detests dishonest scales, but accurate weights find favor with him.
verse.textZh: 诡诈的天平为雅伟所憎恶；公平的法码为他所喜悦。

The journalists claim they were illegally punished for speaking out about the need for...

Micah 6:8 calls us to act justly, love mercy, and walk humbly with our God, principles that should guide institutions as much as individuals in their pursuit of fairness and truth.
reflection.zh: 《星条旗报》的记者们试图维护其报道的公正性，这是一种追求真相和问责制的努力，但却受到机构控制的挑战。弥迦书6:8呼吁我们行公义，好怜悯，谦卑地与神同行，这些原则无论对个人还是机构，在追求公正和真相时都应予以遵循。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: The White House launched a video game. A major games company is not impressed
title.zh: 白宫推出电子游戏，一家主要游戏公司表示不满

summary.en: The company behind the long-running video game franchise Tetris claims the White House used its intellectual property without permission for a controversial online game called 'Build the Wall.' The Tetris Company stated it was not involved in the game's creation and did not authorize the use of its brand or IP.
summary.zh: 《俄罗斯方块》系列游戏背后的一家公司表示，白宫在未经许可的情况下使用了该公司的知识产权，用于一款名为“建造墙壁”的有争议的在线游戏中。《俄罗斯方块》公司声明，他们并未参与该游戏的制作，也没有授权或许可使用“俄罗斯方块”品牌或知识产权。

body.en:
The company behind the long-running puzzle video game series Tetris has said that it did not give permission for the White House to use the game's iconic imagery for a controversial online arcade that the Trump administration released on Friday.

"The Tetris Company was not involved in the creation of ‘Build the Wall’ and did not authorise or license the Tetris brand or intellectual property for the game," Tetris told the Agence France-Presse (AFP) news agency in a statement.

A block-stacking game called Build the Wall included instructions to "protect the border from the coming horde."

The arcade-style games and promotional content used by the Trump administration contain images that resemble games created by Tetris and other major game developers, including Sega, Microsoft-owned Xbox and the Flappy Bird Foundation.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"At Tetris, we believe in the power of connection and bringing people together, not dividing them," Tetris said in a social media post.

Promotional content posted by the White House on social media also included images that resemble trademarks and designs from Microsoft-owned Xbox.

Microsoft did not respond to requests for comment, and the Sega Corporation couldn't immediately be reached.

The White House released several games Friday, with a placeholder that teased another one "coming soon."

The web-only games, which were published on the official White House website under a new page called "arcade," sparked condemnation for racist themes and prompted questions about potential copyright violations.

In one clip, the letters from the Sega logo transform into MAGA, a term that stands for Make America Great Again, which President Trump turned into his campaign slogan during his first presidential run for the 2016 election.

A game called "Flappy Bill" features a bald eagle carrying a document in its claws that tries to avoid smashing into columns of various heights, against a background that resembles Washington DC.

"This administration is laser focused on ways to innovate and tell the story of the President's many accomplishments in a way that resonates with every American," the White House said Thursday in a statement to AFP.

"Makes me sick. They've been playing games with people's lives for years, now they've made a video game of what they're doing," Amerika Garcia Grewal, co-director of the Frontera Federation in Eagle Pass, Texas, told AFP.

"There's no attention paid to the quality of life for human beings, both those in their game or those in real life. We who live in the borderlands are US citizens and yet are treated with suspicion and violence," she added.

reflection.en: The story of the Tower of Babel in Genesis 11 describes humanity's ambition to build a great city and tower, reaching toward the heavens. This ambition, unchecked by humility or divine guidance, led to confusion and scattering. Similarly, the White House's use of Tetris imagery without permission for a politically charged game, despite the creators'...
reflection.zh: 《创世记》第11章中关于巴别塔的故事，描述了人类建造宏伟城市和高塔、直达天际的野心。这种野心若没有谦卑或神的指引，就可能导致混乱和分散。同样，白宫未经许可就将“俄罗斯方块”的图像用于政治色彩浓厚的游戏，并且在游戏创作者提出异议后仍我行我素，这似乎也反映了一种越权行为，即野心或政治信息盖过了对他人权利和合作精神的尊重。

verse.textEn: Yahweh said, 'If as one people speaking the same language they have begun to do this, then nothing they plan to do will be impossible for them.'
verse.textZh: 雅伟说：「看哪，他们成为一样的人民，都是一样的言语，如今既做起这事来，以后他们所要做的事就没有不成就的了。」

title.en: Outrage as Maltese tycoon acquitted in journalist's murder
title.zh: 震惊：马耳他巨头记者谋杀案无罪

summary.en: Maltese businessman Yorgen Fenech has been acquitted of complicity in the murder of journalist Daphne Caruana Galizia. The verdict, delivered nearly nine years after the attack, leaves the question of who ordered her death unresolved, sparking outrage from the public and the victim's family.
summary.zh: 马耳他商人尤尔根·费内赫被判无罪，此前他被指控共谋杀害记者达芙妮·卡鲁阿纳·加利齐亚。这起袭击事件发生近九年后，谁下令杀害她的问题仍未得到解答，这在公众和受害者家属中引发了愤怒。

body.en:
Maltese businessman Yorgen Fenech has been found not guilty of complicity to murder journalist Daphne Caruana Galizia. Almost nine years after the attack, the question of who ordered her death remains unanswered.

As Yorgen Fenech left the courthouse in Valletta on Wednesday evening, he was confronted by the furious crowd outside. The 44-year-old Maltese businessman pushed through, flanked by his security guards. Just minutes earlier, a jury had acquitted him of ordering the murder of the 53-year-old investigative journalist Daphne Caruana Galizia.

The verdict came as a shock to her family. Her son, Matthew Caruana Galizia, said it was a "terrible decision by the jurors that our country may never recover from." He later doubled down on his criticism, describing the verdict in a post on Facebook as "obscene" and saying: "Their decision flies in the face of all evidence, of all logic, of the truth."

Almost nine years after Caruana Galizia's murder, Malta is again confronted with the crucial question: Who was responsible for her death on October 16, 2017? The men who procured the bomb, placed it under the driver's seat and detonated it remotely have already been convicted . But the person who contracted them to do it has still not been legally identified.

For years, Fenech was considered to be the central figure in the investigations. His arrest on the morning of November 20, 2019, was like something out of a movie. His luxury yacht, Gio, had just left harbor when it was stopped by a Maltese military patrol boat. Fenech was arrested on board and subsequently interrogated by the police.

Fenech's arrest, and suspicion that people in government circles were involved in the crime, sparked protests all across the country. Joseph Muscat, prime minister at the time, was accused of protecting political allies and stepped down in January 2020. Fenech spent more than five years in detention before being released on bail, under strict conditions, in early 2025.

His trial only began this summer , and the final verdict was decisive. Eight of the nine jurors rejected the prosecution's argument that it was Fenech who had ordered the journalist's murder.

The prosecution case relied above all on the testimony of Melvin Theuma, who confessed to being the middleman and testified that Fenech had contracted him to organize the murder. Theuma received a pardon in exchange for his cooperation.

But Fenech's defense called Theuma's credibility into question, highlighting contradictions in his testimony and false statements he had made previously.

Fenech's lawyers also sought to prove that evidence pointing to Keith Schembri, chief of staff to Muscat at the time, was not properly followed up. Schembri has denied any involvement in the murder, and the...
body.zh: 马耳他商人约根·费内奇 (Yorgen Fenech) 被判无罪谋杀记者达芙妮·卡鲁阿纳·加利齐亚 (Daphne Caruana Galizia)。袭击发生近九年后，谁下令杀害她的问题仍然没有答案。 周三晚上，当约根·费内奇 (Yorgen Fenech) 离开瓦莱塔法院时，他遇到了外面愤怒的人群。这位 44 岁的马耳他商人在保安的簇拥下推门而入。就在几分钟前，陪审团宣布他下令谋杀 53 岁调查记者达芙妮·卡鲁阿纳·加利齐亚 (Daphne Caruana Galizia) 无罪。 这一判决令她的家人感到震惊。她的儿子马修·卡鲁阿纳·加利齐亚 (Matthew Caruana Galizia) 表示，这是“陪审团做出的可怕决定，我们的国家可能永远无法从中恢复过来”。后来他加大了批评力度，在脸书上发帖称这一判决“淫秽”，并表示：“他们的决定违背了所有证据、所有逻辑和事实。” 卡鲁阿娜·加利齐亚 (Caruana Galizia) 被谋杀近九年后，马耳他再次面临关键问题：谁应对 2017 年 10 月 16 日她的死亡负责？购买炸弹、将其放置在驾驶员座椅下并远程引爆的人已被定罪。但与他们签约的人的身份仍未得到合法确认。 多年来，费内奇被认为是调查的核心人物。他于2019年11月20日上午被捕，就像电影里的情节一样。他的豪华游艇“Gio”刚刚离开港口，就被一艘马耳他军事巡逻艇拦住。费内奇在船上被捕，随后受到警方审问。 费内奇被捕，以及政府人士涉嫌参与犯罪的怀疑，引发了全国各地的抗议活动。时任总理约瑟夫·马斯喀特 (Joseph Muscat) 被指控保护政治盟友，并于 2020 年 1 月下台。费内奇 (Fenech) 被拘留了五年多，然后于 2025 年初在严格条件下获得保释。 他的审判今年夏天才开始，最终的判决是决定性的。九名陪审员中的八名驳回了检方关于是费内奇下令谋杀记者的论点。 检方的指控首先依赖于梅尔文·西玛 (Melvin Theuma) 的证词，他承认自己是中间人，并证明芬内奇与他签约组织了这起谋杀案。作为合作的交换，Theuma 获得了赦免。 但费内奇的辩护对西玛的可信度提出了质疑，强调了他的证词中的矛盾以及他之前所做的虚假陈述。 费内奇的律师还试图证明指向当时马斯喀特参谋长基思·谢姆布里的证据没有得到适当的跟进。申布里否认与这起谋杀案有任何牵连，而且……

reflection.en: The acquittal of Yorgen Fenech in the murder of Daphne Caruana Galizia leaves a deep wound of injustice. The family's anguish and the public's fury underscore the cry for accountability when the legal system fails to deliver justice. This echoes Habakkuk's lament over a broken justice system, where the law is paralyzed and the wicked go unpunished.
reflection.zh: 尤尔根·费内赫在达芙妮·卡鲁阿纳·加利齐亚谋杀案中的无罪判决留下了深深的不公创伤。家属的痛苦和公众的愤怒，凸显了当法律体系未能伸张正义时，对问责制的呼喊。这呼应了哈巴谷对破碎司法体系的哀叹，即法律瘫痪而恶人逍遥法外。

verse.textEn: The law is paralyzed, and justice never prevails. The wicked hem in the righteous, so that justice is perverted.
verse.textZh: 因此律法放松，公理也不显明；恶人围困义人，所以公理显然颠倒。

title.en: Yemen: Fighting intensifies amid Houthi push in the west
title.zh: 也门：胡塞武装在西部加剧冲突

summary.en: Houthi forces are intensifying their fight to gain control of strategic high ground and the entrance to the Red Sea in southwestern Yemen. The Iran-backed militia broke off a fragile truce with the Saudi-backed government-in-exile in July, leading to renewed ground offensives and significant losses on both sides.
summary.zh: 胡塞武装正加剧争夺也门西南部战略高地和红海入口的控制权。受伊朗支持的该民兵组织于7月打破了与沙特支持的流亡政府之间脆弱的停火协议，导致双方遭受重大损失并重新爆发地面攻势。

body.zh: 胡塞武装正试图夺取制高点，巩固对西南部红海入口的控制。伊朗支持的民兵组织于七月份放弃了与沙特支持的流亡政府之间不稳定的休战协议。 也门长期内战双方都因胡塞民兵试图夺取西部红海门户的控制权而遭受损失。 伊朗支持的胡塞武装控制着首都萨那和该国大部分地区，周四对沙特阿拉伯领导的支持也门流亡政府的联盟发动地面攻势。 目前尚未正式公布伤亡数字，但新闻机构援引非公开消息人士的话说，双方均造成数十人伤亡，还有平民在战斗中丧生。截至周五，法新社统计有 129 人死亡。 官员们还报告说，炮击和炮火迫使数百个家庭逃离荷台达和莫卡这两个沿海城市，冲突双方都控制着这两个城市。 也门已经处于内战状态近12年了，今年7月在海湾地区与伊朗的战争中，一段相对平静的时期被打破。 胡塞武装的目标是沙特领导的部队控制的港口和高地，这将加强他们对曼德海峡的控制，该海峡是红海与亚丁湾的交汇处，通向阿拉伯海和公海。 它始终是一条重要的水道，在霍尔木兹海峡的交通受到限制的情况下，它的重要性变得更加重要。 胡塞武装宣布封锁接近沙特阿拉伯西海岸的船只，通过霍尔木兹进入沙特阿拉伯东部港口的通道已经受阻。但他们并没有处于理想的位置或能力来实现他们所表达的愿望。 然而，尽管他们对相关海岸线的控制并不完善，但他们已经向几艘商船开火，造成了一些严重损害和死亡。 军方消息人士私下告诉德新社和法新社，双方均造成多人伤亡。 DPA 统计的双方人数均为数十人，法新社则更准确地估计双方人数约为 60 人。 据报道，西南两个省份塔伊兹和荷台达发生了陆地交火以及火箭和无人机的交火。 胡塞武装控制着荷台达北部的主要西部港口，但也门西南端塔伊兹的大部分地区，包括海峡附近的莫卡港，都由沙特领导的部队控制。 美国风险咨询公司 Basha Report 的穆罕默德·巴沙 (Mohammed al-Basha) 告诉法新社：“他们的目标是巴布·曼德布 (Bab al-Mandeb)”。 争夺制高点，例如在努曼山上俯瞰......

reflection.en: The relentless cycle of conflict in Yemen, marked by the current Houthi push for control of the Red Sea entrance, underscores the devastating human cost of war. Amidst the sounds of battle and the breaking of truces, we are reminded of the prophetic vision of a world where weapons are rendered useless and peace prevails, a hope that sustains believers even...
reflection.zh: 也门冲突的无情循环，以胡塞武装当前争夺红海入口控制权的行动为标志，凸显了战争对人类造成的毁灭性代价。在战火和停火破裂的声音中，我们被提醒了那个武器被废弃、和平得以盛行的预言性景象，这一希望即使在最黑暗的时刻也能支撑信徒。

verse.textEn: He makes wars cease to the ends of the earth; he breaks the bow and shatters the spear.
verse.textZh: 他止息刀兵，直到地极；他折弓断枪。

title.en: Nigeria: Suspected oil thieves dead after inhaling fumes
title.zh: 尼日利亚：涉嫌盗油者吸入烟雾死亡

summary.en: A Nigerian environmental group reports that at least 37 people died while attempting to illegally siphon crude oil from a ship. Police confirmed a fatal incident but provided fewer details, stating that investigations are ongoing.
summary.zh: 尼日利亚一个环保组织称，至少有37人在试图非法从船上盗取原油时死亡。警方证实发生了致命事件，但提供的细节较少，并表示调查仍在进行中。

body.zh: 尼日利亚环保组织表示，至少有 37 人在试图从船上非法抽取原油时死亡。警方承认发生了一起致命事件，但提供的细节较少，称调查仍在继续。 尼日利亚一个环保非政府组织表示，在该国南部试图从一艘装货船上非法开采石油的过程中，至少有 37 人死亡。 青年与宣传中心表示，他们中的大多数人因吸入有害烟雾而死亡。 尼日利亚当局尚未公布死亡人数，但承认发生了一起致命事件，其中有人被杀，显然是在试图窃取原油时。 这起事件于周四夜间发生在该国南部石油资源丰富的尼日尔三角洲河流州的奥克里卡。 该环保组织表示，这起事件发生在码头，当时一艘船只正在通过哈科特港炼油厂从 Indorama Eleme 石化厂装载石油。死者是“疑似石油窃贼”，他们试图在“非法采油点”将石油转移到船上。 非政府组织青年与倡导中心援引志愿者网络的话说，还有其他人失踪，可能是在水中失踪了。 警方承认发生了一起事件，但表示他们将继续调查细节。 发言人布莱辛·阿格巴贝 (Blessing Agbabe) 表示：“河流州警察指挥部可以确认死亡事件。据称，受害者试图窃取原油。” 在非洲最大的石油生产国尼日利亚的尼日尔三角洲地区，石油盗窃相当普遍，该地区的石油矿区是贫困和环境退化的热点地区。 尼日利亚政府估计，石油盗窃行为每年造成数十亿美元的损失，并一直在努力打击这种行为。 如果得到证实，这将是至少自 2023 年 10 月以来有记录以来与企图盗窃石油有关的最严重的致命事故。 不过，尼日利亚安全和民防部队表示，流传的伤亡数字尚未得到证实，并表示正在与其他安全机构合作澄清细节。 如果您信赖我们团队的可信报道，请花点时间选择我们作为您在 Google 上的首选来源，这样您始终会首先看到我们经过验证的新闻。

reflection.en: The tragic deaths of 37 individuals attempting to steal oil underscore the desperate measures people may take when driven by economic hardship or greed. The Bible warns in 1 Timothy 6:10 that the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil, leading some to stray from the faith and pierce themselves with many pains. This incident serves as a somber reminder...
reflection.zh: 37人试图盗油身亡的悲剧，凸显了在经济困境或贪婪驱使下，人们可能采取的绝望手段。《圣经》在提摩太前书6章10节警告说，贪财是万恶之源，它使人离弃真道，用许多忧愁将自己刺透。这一事件令人痛心地提醒我们，非法致富的追求可能带来多么毁灭性的后果。

verse.textEn: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil.
verse.textZh: 贪财是万恶之根。

title.en: Nepal flood disaster puts climate justice under spotlight
title.zh: 尼泊尔洪水灾难将气候正义推向聚光灯下

summary.en: Devastating Himalayan glacial floods have brought climate justice to the forefront, raising questions about responsibility and cost for climate-related disasters. The floods in Nepal's Bhotekoshi-Trisuli river basin have resulted in over 1,250 confirmed deaths, nearly 4,000 missing, and an estimated $2.6 billion in...
summary.zh: 毁灭性的喜马拉雅冰川洪水将气候正义推向了聚光灯下，引发了关于气候相关灾害责任和成本的问题。尼泊尔Bhotekoshi-Trisuli河流域的洪水已导致超过1250人确认死亡，近4000人失踪，并造成约26亿美元的基础设施损失，包括建筑物、桥梁、道路和水电设施。

body.en:
The devastating Himalayan glacial floods have raised broader questions about who should bear the costs and responsibility for the impacts of climate-related disasters.

Days after devastating floods swept through Nepal's Bhotekoshi-Trisuli river basin, the true scale of the disaster is still emerging.  

More than 1,250 people have been confirmed dead and almost 4,000 are still missing.

Buildings, bridges, roads and more than a dozen hydropower facilities have been destroyed, causing an estimated $2.6 billion (€2.24 billion) in damage to public and private infrastructure, according to the National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Authority (NDRRMA).

Search and rescue operations for missing people remain underway, with families still hoping for their safe return.

The exact cause of the glacial collapse remains unclear, but experts say climate change is causing glaciers to melt worldwide, increasing the risk of such disasters.

For Nepal, the disaster has raised a question that goes beyond rescue and reconstruction.

It's about climate justice and who should bear the costs and responsibility for such environmental disasters when the Himalayan nation contributes only a tiny fraction of global greenhouse gas emissions yet faces increasingly severe climate-related risks.

Nepal's Prime Minister Balendra Shah said responding to the catastrophe is a "global responsibility."

"As we work tirelessly to address the damage caused by this sudden and massive disaster, a deeper question has also emerged: How did this destruction happen to us?" Shah asked while addressing Parliament this week.

"Mitigating and managing its impacts is regarded as a shared responsibility of the international community," he stressed.

Kathmandu is planning to raise climate justice issues in the upcoming United Nations General Assembly session in New York, where Prime Minister Shah himself is likely to lead the Nepali delegation.

"We will make our case about the impact of climate change and seek global support and moral obligation to tackle it," Nepal's Foreign Minister Shisir Khanal told DW. "We will also take the initiative of building a coalition of climate-vulnerable countries to raise our collective concerns."

Nepal, a largely rural nation of 30 million people, has contributed little to the greenhouse gas emissions driving global warming.

The country accounts for just 0.1% of global greenhouse gas emissions and emits about 0.5 tons of CO₂ per person each year, making it a "negligible contributor to climate change," according to the World Bank.

But the landlocked Himalayan nation is highly vulnerable to the effects of climate change, with...
body.zh: 毁灭性的喜马拉雅冰川洪水引发了更广泛的问题，即谁应该承担气候相关灾害影响的成本和责任。 毁灭性洪水席卷尼泊尔博特科希-特里苏里河流域几天后，灾难的真正规模仍在显现。 已确认超过 1,250 人死亡，近 4,000 人仍失踪。 据国家减少灾害风险和管理局 (NDRRMA) 称，建筑物、桥梁、道路和十多个水力发电设施被毁，造成公共和私人基础设施损失估计达 26 亿美元（22.4 亿欧元）。 失踪人员的搜救行动仍在进行中，家人仍希望他们能安全返回。 冰川崩塌的确切原因尚不清楚，但专家表示，气候变化正在导致全球范围内的冰川融化，增加了发生此类灾害的风险。 对于尼泊尔来说，这场灾难提出的问题超出了救援和重建的范围。 这是关于气候正义，以及当喜马拉雅国家只占全球温室气体排放量的一小部分却面临着日益严重的气候相关风险时，谁应该承担此类环境灾难的成本和责任。 尼泊尔总理巴伦德拉·沙阿表示，应对这场灾难是“全球责任”。 “当我们不知疲倦地努力解决这场突然发生的大规模灾难造成的损害时，一个更深层次的问题也出现了：这种破坏是如何发生在我们身上的？”沙阿本周在议会发表讲话时问道。 “减轻和管理其影响被视为国际社会的共同责任，”他强调。 加德满都计划在即将在纽约举行的联合国大会会议上提出气候正义问题，沙阿总理本人可能会率领尼泊尔代表团出席会议。 尼泊尔外交部长希西尔·卡纳尔对德国之声表示：“我们将阐述气候变化的影响，并寻求全球支持和道德义务来应对这一问题。” “我们还将主动建立气候脆弱国家联盟，以提出我们的集体关切。” 尼泊尔是一个拥有 3000 万人口、以农村为主的国家，对导致全球变暖的温室气体排放几乎没有造成什么影响。 据世界银行称，中国仅占全球温室气体排放量的 0.1%，每年每人排放约 0.5 吨二氧化碳，使其“对气候变化的影响可以忽略不计”。 但这个内陆喜马拉雅国家非常容易受到气候变化的影响，...

reflection.en: The earth itself groans, bearing the weight of human impact and the consequences of a fallen world. The devastating floods in Nepal, which have claimed so many lives and destroyed vital infrastructure, are a stark reminder of this reality. As we witness such tragedies, we are called to consider our stewardship of creation and the interconnectedness of our...
reflection.zh: 大地本身也在呻吟，承受着人类活动的影响和一个堕落世界的后果。尼泊尔毁灭性的洪水夺走了许多生命并摧毁了重要的基础设施，这是对这一现实的严峻提醒。当我们目睹这样的悲剧时，我们被呼召要反思我们对受造界的管理，以及我们行为与地球及其居民福祉之间的相互联系。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: India news: 275 Indians still missing in Nepal floods
title.zh: 印度新闻：尼泊尔洪水仍有275名印度人失踪

summary.en: Official estimates indicate that 275 Indians remain unaccounted for following the catastrophic floods in Nepal. Concurrently, reports suggest no Indian travelers are stranded in flood-affected Tibet.
summary.zh: 官方估计显示，在尼泊尔灾难性的洪水之后，仍有275名印度人下落不明。与此同时，有报道称没有印度旅客滞留在受洪水影响的西藏地区。

body.zh: 官方估计，尼泊尔洪水灾难中仍有 275 名印度人下落不明。与此同时，据说没有印度游客滞留在受洪水影响的西藏。 DW还有更多。 厌倦了错过我们的实时更新？单击此处将我们添加为 Google 上的首选来源。然后点击“星标”或“首选”，将 DW News 保留在您的 Feed 顶部。 印度表示，在山洪袭击尼泊尔和西藏边境地区十天后，仍有 275 名印度国民失踪。 印度外交部发言人兰迪尔·贾伊斯瓦尔(Randhir Jaiswal)周五晚间表示，迄今为止，尼泊尔洪灾地区共有169名印度人获救。 杰斯瓦尔表示，在最新的救援行动中，三名印度人，包括一名五岁儿童，被从尼泊尔特里苏利集市救至安全地带。 “我们驻尼泊尔大使馆正在协助他们乘飞机返回印度，”他在 X 日表示。 该发言人在新德里举行的新闻发布会上表示，1,907 名印度国民已从中国安全越境前往尼泊尔。 杰斯瓦尔援引中国官方消息来源宣布，目前没有印度旅客滞留在西藏自治区。 尼泊尔官方公布的洪水死亡人数目前为 1,294 人，仍有 5,053 人失踪。 为了寻找幸存者，疯狂的救援工作已经持续了数天，特别是在充满泥浆的水电隧道中，据信有数百名工人被困。 周六，新德里驻加德满都特使表示，印度隧道救援队与尼泊尔国防军在拉苏瓦奇莱姆水电站合作，已加强行动。 印度大使纳文·斯里瓦斯塔瓦（Naveen Srivastava）表示：“昨天，印度隧道救援队与尼泊尔军队合作，在奇莱姆隧道中挖得更深，排水。还修建了一条临时轨道，以便更多重型设备进入隧道。” 他补充说，陪同印度救援人员的医生还为当地社区举办了一个健康营。 杰斯瓦尔周五表示，自 8 月 26 日洪水袭击尼泊尔以来，印度还向尼泊尔提供了近 95 吨救灾物资。 我是来自德国之声德里工作室的 Dharvi，为您带来我们印度博客的周末版，我们将详细分析在这个世界上人口最多的国家引起轰动的所有头条新闻。 尼泊尔-西藏灾难性洪灾中仍有 275 名印度人失踪，死亡人数已突破 1,200 人。 外交消息方面，下周金砖国家峰会在新德里已经开始倒计时。印度将作为经济集团主席国接待成员国领导人。 与此同时，在体育界，印度运动员正在以一种相当非传统的方式为亚运会做准备——睡在集装箱式的单位里。

reflection.en: Amidst the devastation of the Nepal floods, 275 Indian nationals are still missing. This crisis underscores the vulnerability of travelers and the profound human need for safety and connection. In these moments of uncertainty and loss, we are called to remember that compassion extended to those in distress, even strangers, is an act of service to the divine.
reflection.zh: 在尼泊尔洪水灾难的背景下，仍有275名印度国民失踪。这场危机凸显了旅客的脆弱性以及人类对安全和联系的深切需求。在这些充满不确定和失落的时刻，我们被呼召要铭记，向处于困境中的人，即使是陌生人，伸出援手，也是一种对神圣的服侍。

verse.textEn: Truly I tell you, whatever you did for one of the least of these brothers and sisters of mine, you did for me.
verse.textZh: 我实在告诉你们，这些事你们既做在我这弟兄中一个最小的身上，就是做在我身上了。

title.en: Watch: Moment workers are rescued from Nepal tunnel
title.zh: 视频：尼泊尔隧道工人获救瞬间

summary.en: Rescuers pull two people from a hydropower tunnel more than a week after a massive flash flood devastated the Nepal-China border.
summary.zh: 在导致尼泊尔-中国边境地区遭受毁灭性洪灾一周多后，救援人员从一座水电站隧道中救出了两人。

reflection.en: In the aftermath of disaster, the focus often shifts to the immense scale of destruction. Yet, amidst the rubble and the waiting, the rescue of two individuals from the Nepal tunnel shines a light on the preciousness of each human life. Jesus taught that whatever we do for the least of these, we do for Him.
reflection.zh: 在灾难的余波中，人们的注意力常常转向巨大的破坏规模。然而，在瓦砾和等待之中，从尼泊尔隧道中救出两名个人的事件，彰显了每个人的生命都何等宝贵。耶稣教导说，凡你们为我这些最小的弟兄做的，就是为我做的。

verse.textEn: Truly I tell you, whatever you did for one of the least of these brothers and sisters of mine, you did for me.
verse.textZh: 我实在告诉你们，这些事你们既做在我这弟兄中一个最小的身上，就是做在我身上了。

title.en: ‘Everyone seems to have forgotten’: In Tibet, flood-hit families search for the missing and grapple with China’s silence
title.zh: 在西藏，“每个人似乎都已忘记”：洪水肆虐家庭寻找失踪者，并与中国的沉默作斗争

summary.en: Relatives are trying to gather information online and from Nepal, while Tibet advocacy groups report that information is being suppressed in China. Fan Hong last heard from her husband, Lin Bo, who was working on a Chinese highway project in Nepal, on the morning of the disaster. Over a week later, she is desperately...
summary.zh: 亲属们正试图从网上和尼泊尔收集信息，而西藏倡导团体则报告信息在中国受到压制。范红在尼泊尔-西藏灾难发生当晚听到了她丈夫林波的消息，林波当时正在尼泊尔的一个中国公路项目上工作。一周多过去了，她仍在绝望地寻找他，难以从当局那里获得信息，并转向了社交媒体。

body.en: Relatives try to piece together information found online and from Nepal as Tibet advocates groups say information is suppressed in China Fan Hong last heard from her husband on the morning of the Nepal-Tibet disaster. More than a week later, the 31-year-old is desperately searching for information about Lin Bo, who was working on a Chinese highway project in Nepal. Struggling to get information from authorities, Fan turned to social media for help. “My husband works on a project in Nepal, about 5 kilometres from the Gyirong border crossing. I want to know what the situation is, but I haven’t been able to reach him,” the 31-year-old from China’s Sichuan province wrote on Rednote. Continue reading...
body.zh: 亲戚们试图将网上和来自尼泊尔的信息拼凑起来，因为西藏倡导团体称信息在中国受到压制。 范红最后一次听到她丈夫的消息是在尼泊尔-西藏灾难发生的早上。一个多星期后，这位31岁的男子正在拼命寻找有关林波的信息，林波正在尼泊尔的一个中国高速公路项目上工作。由于难以从当局获取信息，范向社交媒体寻求帮助。 “我丈夫在尼泊尔的一个项目工作，距离吉隆口岸约 5 公里。我想知道情况如何，但一直联系不上他，”这位来自中国四川省的 31 岁男子在 Rednote 上写道。继续阅读...

reflection.en: In the aftermath of the Nepal-Tibet disaster, families like Fan Hong's are left in agonizing uncertainty, struggling to find information about their missing loved ones. The silence from authorities and the difficulty in accessing news echo the plight of those who are often voiceless. This situation calls us to remember and advocate for those whose suffering...
reflection.zh: 在尼泊尔-西藏灾难发生后，像范红这样的家庭陷入了痛苦的不确定之中，努力寻找失踪亲人的信息。当局的沉默和获取新闻的困难，呼应了那些常常无声者的困境。这种情况提醒我们要铭记并为那些可能被遗忘的受苦者发声，这体现了圣经中为不能为自己发声者说话的呼召。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Pacific leaders voice concern over Chinese missile test but stop short of condemnation
title.zh: 太平洋领导人对中国导弹试验表示担忧，但未予谴责

summary.en: The Pacific Islands Forum (PIF) concluded with most member nations agreeing to "register concern" over China's recent intercontinental ballistic missile (ICBM) test, which overflew several members without adequate notice. Leaders urged transparency and advance notification for such tests, with Nauru being the sole...
summary.zh: 太平洋岛国论坛（PIF）闭幕，多数成员国同意就中国近期洲际弹道导弹（ICBM）试验“表示关切”，该试验在未获充分通知的情况下飞越了部分成员国领土。领导人敦促所有进行ICBM试验的国家确保透明度和保障，包括按照国际惯例至少提前24小时发出通知。18个成员国中，瑙鲁是唯一一个对此条款持异议的国家。

body.en:
The Pacific Islands Forum (PIF) has wrapped up with most nations agreeing to "register concern" on China's recent intercontinental ballistic missile (ICBM) test, "which overflew a number of members without adequate notice".

"Leaders call on all states undertaking ICBM testing to ensure transparency and reassurance, including through the provision of advance notification of a test at least 24 hours in accordance with international practice," the communique says, as read out by Palau's President and PIF chair Surangel Whipps Junior, after the closing ceremony.

In a rare move for the usually consensus-based forum, Nauru was the only one of 18 PIF members to dissent from the clause.

Kiribati and Nauru were the only two Pacific nations that had previously blocked a draft PIF statement in the immediate aftermath of Beijing's test, a move that Prime Minister Anthony Albanese had been advocating for.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

However the statement went further than analysts and government sources had expected; the PIF foreign ministers' meeting statement in August was broader, discussing ballistic missile testing in the region, but had stopped short of singling out a particular ICBM or referencing a notice period for nations to undergo any testing.

Whipps also hit back against China's comments that Palau sensationalised its ballistic missile test, saying: "There's no sensationalism, it's just stating the facts."

"The Pacific Islands weren't informed [of the test]. The ones that were informed were informed late, and so I think the message from the forum is clear: that transparency needs to happen."

Intelligence shows the nuclear-capable intercontinental ballistic missile test in July flew over the Philippines, Palau and Micronesia's airspace before landing in the Pacific Ocean.

The response has become something of a litmus test for PIF and its members for their strategic positioning.

The communique's relevant clause includes a reference to the Fiji-led Ocean of Peace declaration made last year, which states the region should be free from coercion and militarisation.

However, it doesn't name China, nor does it use heftier diplomatic language than "concern".

While Australian officials were happy with the agreed statement, it fell short of some pre-retreat expectations, including those of the host, Palau.

"They sent a missile next to French Polynesia, another one next to Tuvalu, crossing over our airspace. They never bothered to tell us that's what's happening," he said.

"I said 'there's a lot of space between Japan and Guam, why don't you send it there? Why does it have to come to the middle of the Pacific when last year we just signed a...
body.zh: 太平洋岛屿论坛（PIF）结束时，大多数国家同意对中国最近的洲际弹道导弹（ICBM）试验“表达关切”，“该试验在没有充分通知的情况下飞越了一些成员国”。 帕劳总统兼太平洋岛国论坛主席苏兰吉尔·惠普斯·儒尼奥尔在闭幕式后宣读的公报称，“领导人呼吁所有进行洲际弹道导弹测试的国家确保透明度和保证，包括根据国际惯例至少提前 24 小时提前通知测试情况”。 对于这个通常以共识为基础的论坛来说，这是一个罕见的举动，瑙鲁是 18 个 PIF 成员中唯一不同意该条款的国家。 基里巴斯和瑙鲁是此前在北京试验后立即阻止PIF声明草案的仅有的两个太平洋国家，此举是总理安东尼·阿尔巴内斯一直倡导的。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 然而，该声明超出了分析师和政府消息人士的预期；太平洋岛国论坛外交部长八月份的会议声明范围更广，讨论了该地区的弹道导弹试验，但没有单独指出特定的洲际弹道导弹或提及各国进行任何试验的通知期。 惠普斯还反驳了中国关于帕劳炒作其弹道导弹试验的言论，他说：“没有煽情，只是陈述事实。” “太平洋岛屿没有被告知（这次测试）。那些被告知的人却很晚才被告知，所以我认为论坛传达的信息很明确：需要实现透明度。” 情报显示，7月份进行的具有核能力的洲际弹道导弹试验飞越了菲律宾、帕劳和密克罗尼西亚的领空，然后降落在太平洋上。 这一回应已成为 PIF 及其成员战略定位的试金石。 公报的相关条款包括提及斐济去年发表的《和平海洋宣言》，该宣言指出该地区不应受到胁迫和军事化。 然而，它没有点名中国，也没有使用比“关切”更重的外交语言。 虽然澳大利亚官员对商定的声明感到满意，但它没有达到一些退会前的预期，包括东道主帕劳的预期。 “他们向法属波利尼西亚发射了一枚导弹，又向图瓦卢发射了一枚导弹，飞越了我们的领空。他们从来没有费心告诉我们发生了什么，”他说。 “我说‘日本和关岛之间有很大的空间，你为什么不把它送到那里？为什么它必须来到太平洋中部，去年我们刚刚签署了一份……

reflection.en: The leaders of the Pacific Islands Forum have expressed concern over a recent ICBM test that flew over their territories without sufficient warning. Their call for transparency and advance notification echoes the ancient prophetic vision of a world where such instruments of potential conflict are managed with greater care and consideration for all nations....
reflection.zh: 太平洋岛国论坛的领导人对近期一次未获充分预警便飞越其领土的洲际弹道导弹试验表示关切。他们呼吁提高透明度和提前通知，这呼应了古代先知的异象——一个世界，在那里，潜在冲突的工具能够得到更谨慎的处理，并顾及所有国家。 这一时刻凸显了国家安全利益与地区稳定之间的微妙平衡，敦促在国际事务中走上更加开放和相互保证的道路。

verse.textEn: They will beat their swords into plowshares and their spears into pruning hooks.
verse.textZh: 他们要将刀打成犁头，把枪打成镰刀。

title.en: Reform’s media presenter worked for Chinese state propaganda channel
