This surge in requests, reaching over 3,100 cases, underscores the far-reaching human cost of conflict. It is a reminder that even distant wars can disrupt lives and create a sense of insecurity, prompting people to look for safety and support...
reflection.zh: 中东地区持续的战争产生了连锁反应，促使港人在海外的求助个案增加了35%。这一求助高峰，涉及超过3,100宗个案，凸显了冲突深远的代价。这提醒我们，即使是遥远的战争也会扰乱人们的生活，造成不安全感，促使人们寻求国外的安全与支持。

verse.textEn: He makes wars cease to the ends of the earth; he breaks the bow and shatters the spear.
verse.textZh: 他止息刀兵，直到地极；他折弓断枪。

title.en: Visitors urge Hong Kong to ease restrictions as Sai Kung trail registration begins
title.zh: 游客敦促香港放宽限制，郊野公园开始实行预约制

summary.en: Hundreds of Hong Kong residents and visitors braved the heat on Saturday morning to visit a popular Sai Kung trail overlooking hexagonal rock columns, as a trial reservation system requiring real-name registration came into force, with some calling for the restrictions to be eased.
summary.zh: 周六上午，数百名香港居民和游客不顾炎热，参观了西贡一条俯瞰六方石柱的热门步道，该步道开始实行需要实名登记的试行预约系统，其中一些人呼吁放宽限制。

body.en: Hundreds of Hong Kong residents and visitors braved the heat on Saturday morning to visit a popular Sai Kung trail overlooking hexagonal rock columns, as a trial reservation system requiring real-name registration came into force, with some calling for the restrictions to be eased. The Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department announced the arrangement last month, capping visitor numbers at 2,000 per designated day between 9am and 5pm for the Po Pin Chau section of the High Island Geo...
body.zh: 周六早上，数百名香港居民和游客冒着酷热，参观了一条俯瞰六角形岩柱的热门西贡步道，因为需要实名注册的试行预订系统开始生效，一些人呼吁放宽限制。渔农自然护理署上个月宣布了这项安排，规定万宜地质公园破边洲段每个指定日期上午 9 点至下午 5 点的游客人数上限为 2,000 人。

reflection.en: The crowds flocking to Sai Kung's natural beauty, despite the heat and new registration system, speak to a deep human appreciation for creation. This desire to experience places of wonder echoes the biblical understanding that such experiences, like children, are gifts from Yahweh, enriching our lives and reminding us of His provision.
reflection.zh: 尽管天气炎热且实行了新的登记制度，但涌向西贡自然美景的人群，体现了人类对受造界的深切欣赏。这种体验奇妙之地的渴望，呼应了圣经的理解，即这些体验，如同儿女一样，是雅伟的恩赐，丰富了我们的生活，并提醒我们祂的供应。

verse.textEn: Children are a heritage from Yahweh, offspring a reward from him.
verse.textZh: 儿女是雅伟所赐的产业。

title.en: Overhead display left dangling at airport’s Terminal 2, investigation under way
title.zh: 香港机场二号客运大楼一显示屏悬挂半空，当局展开调查

summary.en: An overhead electronic display at Hong Kong International Airport's newly reopened Terminal 2 was found dangling after a technical fault on Saturday morning. Airport authorities stated they take the incident seriously and will conduct a thorough investigation to enhance system stability.
summary.zh: 香港国际机场新重开的二号客运大楼，周六早上一个悬挂的电子显示屏因技术故障而悬挂半空。机场管理局表示，他们非常重视此次事件，并将进行详细调查，以进一步加强系统的稳定性。

body.en: An overhead electronic display was left dangling in the air at Hong Kong airport’s newly reopened Terminal 2, prompting authorities to pledge a detailed investigation. A spokesman said the incident occurred at about 8.30am on Saturday, when a suspended screen “experienced a technical fault”, triggering its fall-arrest safety system. “The Airport Authority takes the incident very seriously and will conduct a detailed investigation into the cause, with a view to further enhancing the stability of...
body.zh: 香港机场新开放的 2 号航站楼的头顶电子显示屏悬在空中，促使当局承诺展开详细调查。一名发言人表示，这起事件发生在周六上午 8 点 30 分左右，当时悬挂的屏幕“出现技术故障”，触发了防坠落安全系统。 “机场管理局非常重视事件，将会详细调查原因，以期进一步增强机场的稳定性……

reflection.en: When systems fail, especially in public spaces like an airport, the immediate response is often to find the cause and ensure it doesn't happen again. This incident at Hong Kong airport, where a dangling display prompted an investigation, highlights the importance of transparency and accountability when things go wrong. The pursuit of truth, even in...
reflection.zh: 当系统出现故障时，尤其是在机场这样的公共场所，人们的反应通常是找出原因并确保不再发生。香港机场这个悬挂的显示屏事件引发了调查，凸显了在出现问题时透明度和问责制的重要性。追求真相，即使是技术故障的真相，也是恢复信心和安全的一步。

verse.textEn: Then you will know the truth, and the truth will set you free.
verse.textZh: 你们必晓得真理，真理必叫你们得以自由。

title.en: Airport scare as display dangles in mid-air after fall
title.zh: 机场惊魂：显示屏坠落悬空

summary.en: An overhead electronic display at Hong Kong International Airport's Terminal 2 fell approximately seven meters on Saturday, leaving it dangling in mid-air. Fortunately, no one was injured as the marine-themed display landed eight meters above the ground. The incident is believed to have been caused by a steel cable...
summary.zh: 周六，香港国际机场二号客运大楼的一个架空电子显示屏坠落约七米，悬挂在半空中。幸运的是，该海洋主题的显示屏最终停在离地面八米处，无人受伤。事故据信是钢缆断裂所致，机场管理局表示显示屏的坠落制动系统已启动。

body.en: An overhead electronic display at Hong Kong International Airport’s Terminal 2 was left dangling in mid-air after falling about seven metres on Saturday. No one was injured as the marine-themed display ended up eight metres above ground after falling from its original 15-metre-high perch, with the cause believed to be a steel cable giving way. Police said they were alerted at around 8.30 am about the incident involving the 1.5m by 1.5m installation and that there was no immediate danger. Firefighters were on standby at the scene. In a social media post, the Airport Authority said the installation's fall-arrest system came into play during the malfunction and that the area was immediately cordoned off. A maintenance team has further stabilised the installation, the authority said, adding that it would conduct a thorough investigation into the cause of the incident to further enhance the stability of the safety system. “The Airport Authority is deeply concerned about the incident and will thoroughly probe the cause of the incident,” it said. Edited by Robert Kemp
body.zh: 周六，香港国际机场二号航站楼的一个电子显示屏从高空坠落约七米后悬在半空中。这座以海洋为主题的展览从原来 15 米高的位置坠落，最终坠落到距地面 8 米的地方，没有人受伤，原因据信是一根钢缆脱落。警方表示，他们于上午 8.30 左右接到有关涉及 1.5m x 1.5m 装置的事件的警报，但没有立即发生危险。消防人员在现场待命。机场管理局在社交媒体帖子中表示，该装置的防坠落系统在故障期间发挥了作用，该地区立即被封锁。当局表示，维修小组已进一步稳定了装置，并补充说，将彻底调查事故原因，以进一步增强安全系统的稳定性。声明称：“机场管理局对事件深表关注，并将彻底调查事件原因。”罗伯特·坎普编辑

reflection.en: This incident at Hong Kong International Airport, where a large display unexpectedly fell, serves as a reminder of the importance of careful work and maintenance. Even in busy, modern environments, the integrity of structures and systems relies on diligent attention to detail. Colossians 3:23 encourages us to do all our work heartily, as if for Yahweh,...
reflection.zh: 香港国际机场发生的这个大型显示屏意外坠落的事件，提醒我们细致工作和维护的重要性。即使在繁忙的现代化环境中，结构和系统的完整性也依赖于对细节的勤勉关注。歌罗西书3章23节鼓励我们凡事都从心里做，像是为主做的，这体现了一种超越基本要求的严谨标准。

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: Po Pin Chau real-name trial debuts with 1,500 bookings
title.zh: 蒲台岛实名预约试行首日吸引1500人登记

summary.en: On Saturday, approximately 1,500 individuals registered for the Po Pin Chau trail in Sai Kung East Country Park during the inaugural day of a real-name reservation trial. The system allows up to 500 visitors per two-hour slot, with a daily cap of 2,000, requiring bookings via Klook with verified real names. The trial...
summary.zh: 官员周六表示，在西贡东郊野公园蒲台岛行山径实名预约试行首日，约有1500人登记。该计划规定，每两个小时时段最多接待500名访客，每日上限为2000人。访客必须通过Klook平台使用真实姓名进行预约，并在抵达时进行核实。试行期涵盖九月所有周末，其中最后一个周末恰逢中秋节，以及十月的国庆黄金周。

body.en: Officials on Saturday said about 1,500 people registered to visit the Po Pin Chau trail in Sai Kung East Country Park on the first day of a real-name reservation trial. Under the scheme, up to 500 visitors are admitted during each two-hour slot, with the daily number capped at 2,000. Visitors must book via the Klook platform using their real name, which will be verified upon arrival. The trial covers all weekends in September, the last of which coincides with the Mid-Autumn Festival, as well as the National Day Golden Week in October. Director of Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Mickey Lai said operations were smooth on the opening day. "Especially because it’s the first day, we set up some information centres, and we're doing our best to manage crowd flows," he said. "Today's turnout is normal and similar to what we've seen in the past. We will continue to monitor crowd flow every weekend, paying particular attention during the Mid-Autumn Festival and National Day Golden Week holidays." Lai added that walk-in visitors were admitted because some reservation slots were unfilled. A tourist from Suzhou, who made the booking two days ago, found the arrangement to be more suitable. “I saw comments online saying that photos might not turn out well with too many people around. Spreading out the crowds is better and more reasonable," she said. Edited by Robert Kemp _____________________________ Last updated: 2026-09-05 HKT 15:07
body.zh: 官员周六表示，西贡东郊野公园破边洲步道实行实名预约试行首日，已有约 1,500 人登记参观。根据该计划，每两小时最多可容纳 500 名游客，每日入场人数上限为 2,000 人。游客必须通过Klook客路平台使用真实姓名进行预订，抵达时将进行验证。此次试点涵盖9月份的所有周末，其中最后一个周末恰逢中秋节，以及10月份的国庆黄金周。渔农自然护理署署长黎伟明表示，开幕当日运作顺利。 “特别是因为这是第一天，我们设立了一些信息中心，我们正在尽最大努力管理人流，”他说。 “今天的投票率很正常，与过去的情况类似。我们将继续监控每个周末的人流情况，特别是中秋节和国庆黄金周假期期间。”赖补充说，由于一些预约名额未满，因此允许直接入场的游客入场。前两天预订的苏州游客觉得这样的安排比较合适。 “我看到网上有评论说，人太多的话，照片拍出来的效果可能会不好。分散人群比较好，也比较合理。”她说。编辑：Robert Kemp _____________________________ 最后更新：2026-09-05 HKT 15:07

reflection.en: The launch of the Po Pin Chau trail's real-name reservation system marks a new phase in managing visitor access to natural spaces. This careful planning and execution, involving technology and public cooperation, reflects a commitment to order and accessibility. May all such endeavors be committed to Yahweh, trusting in His guidance for their success and...
reflection.zh: 蒲台岛行山径实名预约系统的推出，标志着管理游客进入自然空间的新阶段。这种周密的规划和执行，涉及技术和公众的合作，体现了对秩序和可达性的承诺。愿所有此类努力都奉献给雅伟，信靠祂的指引，以求成功并造福社群。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: Hong Kong’s leader outlines 3 key new growth drivers ahead of first 5-year plan
title.zh: 香港领导人公布首个五年规划前的三大新增长动力

summary.en: Hong Kong's Chief Executive, John Lee Ka-chiu, has identified financial services, innovation and technology, and education as the three primary new growth drivers. This announcement precedes the release of the city's first five-year development plan and his annual policy address, which will detail broad strategies and...
summary.zh: 香港行政长官李家超已将金融服务、创新科技和教育确定为三大主要新增长动力。此举是在该市首个五年发展蓝图和年度施政报告发布之前进行的，报告将详细阐述与国家发展目标相一致的广泛战略和具体措施。

body.en: Hong Kong’s leader has identified financial services, innovation and technology, and education as three key new growth drivers ahead of the unveiling of the city’s inaugural five-year development blueprint and annual policy address. Chief Executive John Lee Ka-chiu said on Saturday that Hong Kong’s first five-year plan would outline broad strategies, set clear development directions and align with the nation’s 15th five-year plan, while the policy address would focus on specific measures. He...
body.zh: 在公布香港首个五年发展蓝图和年度施政报告之前，香港领导人将金融服务、创新科技和教育确定为三大新增长动力。行政长官李家超周六表示，香港第一个五年规划将勾画总体策略，明确发展方向，并与国家“十五五”规划保持一致，而施政报告则侧重于具体措施。他...

reflection.en: As Hong Kong's leader lays out ambitious plans for the city's future, the principle of committing one's endeavors to divine guidance offers a profound perspective. Proverbs 16:3 reminds us that success is not solely dependent on human strategy, but on entrusting our work to Yahweh. May leaders and citizens alike seek wisdom and blessing in their collective...
reflection.zh: 随着香港领导人制定城市未来的宏伟计划，将努力付托于神圣指引的原则提供了一个深刻的视角。《箴言》16:3 提醒我们，成功不仅取决于人类的策略，更在于将我们的工作托付给雅伟。愿领导人和市民在共同追求繁荣和发展的努力中，都能寻求智慧和祝福。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: Schools urged to merge sooner as enrolments fall
title.zh: 教育局促請學校提早合併以應對學生人數下降

summary.en: Hong Kong's Secretary for Education, Christine Choi, has urged primary schools facing declining enrollment to proactively plan for mergers or closures. This advice comes as over 120 primary schools are reducing classes, with about 60 operating only a single class, due to a structural decline in the student population.
summary.zh: 香港教育局局長蔡若蓮週六敦促面臨學生人數下降的 પાયાની શાળાઓ (primary schools) 提前規劃合併或停辦事宜。據統計，超過120所 પાયાની શાળાઓ (primary schools) 已縮減 પાયાની ૧ (primary one)...

body.en: Secretary for Education Christine Choi on Saturday urged primary schools with falling enrolment numbers to plan ahead – advising them to consider merging with other schools or ceasing operations. According to this year’s Primary School Profiles, which cover more than 500 campuses, more than 120 aided and government primary schools have had to trim back the number of primary one classes, with around 60 running just a single class. Speaking on a Commercial Radio programme, Choi noted that school-sponsoring bodies should decide as soon as possible to give parents and students time to prepare. She said the declining student population is a structural trend that will not be reversed over the next five to 10 years. “About eight to 10 years ago, everyone worked very hard to maintain the status quo. This included, among other measures, reducing class sizes, lowering the enrolment threshold and increasing the number of teachers to maintain the number of schools,” Choi said. “But now, we realise the measures that we can take have been exhausted. We have made every adjustment possible. If we continue down this path, it will actually hurt the healthy development of Hong Kong's school ecosystem." Choi encouraged schools to operate on a larger scale, noting that this gives students a richer learning experience and school life. She urged schools not to wait until falling enrolment numbers reach a stage that leaves them with no choice but a merger. Choi said the bureau is giving schools that choose to merge a one-off HK$1 million grant, leaving them with the resources and flexibility to keep surplus teachers and make curriculum adjustments during the transition period. Edited by Robert Kemp
body.zh: 教育局局长蔡徐坤周六敦促入学人数下降的小学提前做好计划，建议它们考虑与其他学校合并或停止运营。根据今年覆盖500多个校园的小学概况，超过120所资助和官立小学不得不削减小学一年级的数量，其中约60所小学只开设一个班级。崔在商业广播节目中发表讲话时指出，学校主办机构应尽快决定给家长和学生时间做好准备。她表示，学生人数下降是结构性趋势，未来五到十年不会逆转。 “大约八到十年前，每个人都非常努力地维持现状。其中包括减少班级规模、降低入学门槛和增加教师数量以维持学校数量等措施，”崔说。 “但现在，我们意识到能采取的措施已经用尽，我们已经做了一切可能的调整。如果继续沿着这条路走下去，实际上会损害香港学校生态系统的健康发展。”崔鼓励学校扩大规模，并指出这可以为学生提供更丰富的学习体验和学校生活。她敦促学校不要等到入学人数下降到让他们别无选择只能合并的地步。蔡说，教育局将向选择合并的学校提供​​一笔过100万港元的拨款，让它们有资源和灵活性，在过渡期间留住富余教师并进行课程调整。罗伯特·坎普编辑

reflection.en: The demographic reality of fewer children in Hong Kong presents a significant challenge for the education system. The call for schools to merge or close prompts reflection on how we prepare the next generation. Proverbs 22:6 reminds us of the importance of guiding children in the way they should go, a principle that applies not only to individual upbringing...
reflection.zh: 香港人口結構的變化，導致兒童人數減少，為教育體系帶來了嚴峻的挑戰。學校面臨合併或停辦的呼籲，促使我們反思如何為下一代做好準備。《箴言》22章6節提醒我們，要照孩子應行的道教訓他，這原則不僅適用於個人教養，也適用於我們為教育他們而建立的結構。

verse.textEn: Start children off on the way they should go, and even when they are old they will not turn from it.
verse.textZh: 教养孩童，使他走当行的道，就是到老他也不偏离。

title.en: Huanggang 'to see 100,000 daily crossings initially'
title.zh: 皇岗口岸料初期日均客流达10万人次

summary.en: The new Huanggang port is projected to see at least 100,000 travelers daily in its initial opening phase, according to Immigration Director Benson Kwok. His department is working with Shenzhen authorities to enhance the efficiency of crossings under a collaborative inspection and joint clearance model, aiming to make...
summary.zh: 根据入境事务处处长郭俊峰的说法，新的皇岗口岸在启用初期预计每日将接待至少10万名旅客。他的部门正与深圳当局合作，在“合作查验、一次放行”的模式下优化通关效率，目标是实现系统互联互通。

body.en: The new Huanggang port is expected to handle at least 100,000 travellers each day in the early phase of its opening, according to Director of Immigration Benson Kwok. Speaking on a Commercial Radio programme on Saturday, he said his department is looking into fine-tuning the operational system with Shenzhen authorities with the aim of further improving the time needed for crossings under the “collaborative inspection and joint clearance” model. "Because the systems in Hong Kong and Shenzhen are different, we have to make them interoperable to ensure that each self-service channel can successfully and accurately transfer the travellers’ identity, facial image and fingerprint data collected at the point of departure to the point of entry." Asked whether the port would be able to reopen before the upcoming National Day Golden Week holiday, Kwok said the SAR and Shenzhen authorities would come up with a date after ensuring it meets the criteria of safe, smooth and efficient operations and stressed that the goal of both parties is for the reopening to happen as soon as possible. When travellers first use the self-service channel at the redeveloped port, he pointed out, the process is expected to take slightly longer than usual as they have to give their consent for their data to be shared with authorities on the entry side for verification purposes. They will also be asked if they agree to the use of facial recognition to enable them to make the crossings, he said, as if they do, they will no longer have to take out travel documents when passing through the crossing in the future. Prior registration for facial recognition will be available soon, Kwok said, through a new app, the launch of which will be announced in due course, or at self-service kiosks at the redeveloped port. Government departments, he said, have been continuing to carry out smaller-scale drills following four major stress tests involving tens of thousands of civil servants. The port's daily handling capacity will be, Kwok said, about 200,000 travellers in the initial stage, with the figure surging to 300,000 later. The department has been recruiting more manpower for the port, adding that more than 100 retired officers have been employed on a contract basis so far. Edited by Robert Kemp
body.zh: 入境事务处处长郭本山表示，新皇岗口岸预计在开放初期每天将接待至少10万名旅客。他在周六的商业广播节目中表示，他的部门正在研究与深圳当局微调操作系统，目的是在“协同检查和联合通关”模式下进一步缩短过境所需的时间。 “由于香港和深圳的系统不同，我们必须使它们能够互操作，以确保每个自助服务渠道都能成功、准确地将出发地收集的旅客身份、面部图像和指纹数据传输到入境地。”当被问及港口是否能够在即将到来的国庆黄金周假期前重新开放时，郭表示，特区和深圳当局将在确保港口符合安全、顺利和高效运营的标准后确定日期，并强调双方的目标是尽快重新开放。他指出，当旅客首次使用重建港口的自助服务通道时，预计该过程将比平时稍长，因为他们必须同意与入境当局共享其数据以进行验证。他说，他们还将被问及是否同意使用面部识别技术过境，如果同意，以后过境时将不再需要携带旅行证件。郭说，面部识别的预先注册很快就会通过一个新的应用程序进行，该应用程序的推出将在适当的时候宣布，或者在重新开发的港口的自助服务亭进行。他说，在四次涉及数万名公务员的大型压力测试之后，政府部门一直在继续进行小规模的演习。郭说，港口初期的日吞吐量约为20万人次，后期将增至30万人次。该部门一直在为港口招聘更多人手，并补充说，到目前为止，已以合同形式雇用了100多名退休人员。罗伯特·坎普编辑

reflection.en: The opening of the new Huanggang port signifies a significant effort in cross-border collaboration and efficiency. As systems are fine-tuned and made interoperable, it reflects a commitment to planning and execution. May all such endeavors be committed to Yahweh, trusting that He directs our steps and blesses our diligent work for the benefit of many.
reflection.zh: 新的皇岗口岸的启用，标志着跨境合作和效率提升方面的一项重要努力。随着系统的调整和互联互通，这体现了对规划和执行的承诺。愿所有此类努力都交托给雅伟，相信祂会指引我们的脚步，并祝福我们勤奋的工作，造福大众。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: HKFP Lens: ‘Love at last sight’ – bidding farewell to Hong Kong’s modernist General Post Office after 50 years
title.zh: HKFP镜头：“最后的凝视之爱”——告别香港50年的现代主义邮政总局

summary.en: When Hong Kong's General Post Office was constructed in Central fifty years ago, conservationists lamented the demolition of the building it replaced. The former General Post Office was an architectural masterpiece of the Edwardian era, featuring grand archways and granite veranda pillars under a distinctive facade of...
summary.zh: 五十年前，当香港邮政总局在香港岛中环建成时，保育人士对它取代的旧建筑被拆毁感到惋惜。旧邮政总局是一座爱德华时代建筑的杰作，拥有宏伟的拱门和花岗岩门廊柱，以及独特的玫瑰色厦门砖外墙，这被认为是抵御南中国海岸风暴的耐用性标杆。邮政总局位于干诺道2号的底层入口。十多年前，香港历史博物馆前总馆长曾称赞它为“香港最美丽的建筑”。

body.en: When the General Post Office was built in Central half a century ago, conservationists mourned the loss of the building it replaced. Exterior of the General Post Office. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. The old General Post Office was a marvel of Edwardian architecture: sweeping archways and granite veranda pillars beneath a distinctive façade of rose-coloured Amoy brick – the gold standard for durability on the storm-lashed South China coast. The GPO’s ground-floor entrance at 2 Connaught Place. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Just over a decade ago, the former chief curator of the Hong Kong Museum of History crowned it “Hong Kong’s most beautiful building” when it stood at the site of what is now World-Wide House. For others , its loss ranked alongside the demolition of the old Hong Kong Club as one of the greatest architectural crimes the city has committed against itself. Post Office Private Boxes on the second floor of the GPO. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. But fast-forward to 2026 and accolades are now pouring in for the much-maligned replacement structure. Ahead of its own demolition, the current modernist General Post Office, erected in 1976, is belatedly finding recognition as an icon of modern Hong Kong heritage. Service counters in the General Post Office. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Crouching just five storeys above the Central harbourfront – its planned stature stunted so as to preserve the sea view from Jardine House – the post office’s sharp lines and white concrete walls buck against its ornate predecessor. Customers queue in the main hall of the GPO. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Yet, in retrospect, it’s clear to see how these design choices reflected the society it was born into: one that, by the 1970s, prized simple, utilitarian structures that served a rapidly growing population first and foremost. In the headlong rush to modernise and develop, form followed function – and decoration was optional. Towers of parcels wait at a GPO counter. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. It’s not the first time a modern landmark has, with time, won the hearts of Hongkongers. A row of desks in the GPO. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. The looming demise of the GPO’s erstwhile neighbour, Edinburgh Place Ferry Pier, sparked spirited protests and a sit-in by conservationists in 2006. Although they failed to protect the 1950s landmark, many saw the movement as a watershed moment that led to the localist movement and pro-democracy mobilisation of the 2010s. A stairwell inside the GPO. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. In North Point, efforts to save the mid-century State Theatre have been ongoing for a decade, with some hard-won concessions from the government and developers. A second-floor window in the GPO overlooks the Court of Final Appeal Building....
body.zh: 半个世纪前，当邮政总局在中环建成时，自然资源保护主义者对它所取代的建筑物的损失表示哀悼。邮政总局的外观。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。旧邮政总局是爱德华时代建筑的奇迹：宽阔的拱门和花岗岩阳台柱子位于独特的玫瑰色厦门砖外墙之下，这是暴风雨肆虐的华南海岸耐用性的黄金标准。 GPO 底层入口位于康诺特广场 2 号。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。就在十多年前，当它矗立在现在的环球大厦旧址时，香港历史博物馆前总馆长将其誉为“香港最美丽的建筑”。对于其他人来说，它的损失与拆除旧香港会一样，是这座城市对自己犯下的最大的建筑罪行之一。邮局私人信箱位于 GPO 二楼。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。但快进到 2026 年，备受诟病的替代结构获得的赞誉纷至沓来。建于 1976 年的现代主义风格的邮政总局在被拆除之前，后来才被认为是现代香港遗产的象征。邮政总局的服务柜台。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。邮局坐落在中环海滨上方仅五层楼高处，其规划的高度被限制，以保留怡和大厦的海景。邮局的锐利线条和白色混凝土墙与其华丽的前身形成鲜明对比。顾客在 GPO 大厅排队。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。然而，回想起来，我们可以清楚地看到这些设计选择如何反映了它诞生的社会：到了 20 世纪 70 年代，这个社会推崇简单、实用的结构，首先是为快速增长的人口服务。在现代化和发展的急速推进中，形式追随功能——装饰是可选的。 GPO 柜台前堆满了包裹。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。随着时间的推移，现代地标赢得了香港人的心，这并不是第一次。 GPO 中的一排办公桌。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。 2006 年，GPO 的昔日邻居爱丁堡广场渡轮码头即将消亡，引发了自然资源保护主义者的激烈抗议和静坐。尽管他们未能保护 1950 年代的地标，但许多人认为这场运动是导致 2010 年代地方主义运动和民主动员的分水岭。 GPO 内的楼梯间。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。在北角，拯救中世纪国家剧院的努力已经持续了十年，政府和开发商做出了一些来之不易的让步。总督察署二楼的一扇窗户俯瞰着终审法院大楼……

reflection.en: For fifty years, the General Post Office building stood in Central, a landmark that has now reached the end of its public service life. The story notes the lament of conservationists for the beautiful Edwardian building it replaced, highlighting the passage of time and the inevitable changes that come with it. Ecclesiastes reminds us that 'there is a time...
reflection.zh: 五十年来，邮政总局大楼矗立在中环，如今它已走到了公众服务生涯的尽头。故事提到保育人士对它取代的爱德华时代美丽建筑的惋惜，突显了时间的流逝以及随之而来的不可避免的变化。《传道书》提醒我们，“凡事都有定期，天下万务都有定时”，这是建筑物的兴衰和城市发展的变迁所体现的真理。

verse.textEn: There is a time for everything, and a season for every activity under the heavens.
verse.textZh: 凡事都有定期，天下万务都有定时。

title.en: Ruth Wang, Chinese lawyer for underground church, flees to Taiwan – rights group
title.zh: 中国地下教会律师王瑞德逃往台湾——人权组织

summary.en: Taiwan has offered temporary shelter to a Chinese citizen, identified by a rights group as Ruth Wang, a lawyer representing detained leaders of Beijing's underground Zion Church. Wang reportedly arrived in Taiwan seeking protection from authorities.
summary.zh: 台湾已为一名中国公民提供临时住所，该公民被一个权利组织确认为王瑞德律师。王律师曾代理北京地下教会锡安教会被拘留的领袖。据报道，王律师于周三抵达台湾，寻求当局的保护。

body.en: Taiwan said Friday it has provided “temporary accommodation” to a Chinese citizen, after a rights group reported that a lawyer representing detained leaders of an underground church in Beijing had fled to the island. Ruth Wang. Photo: Ruth Wang. Taiwan’s top China policy body did not identify the person, but ChinaAid said Ruth Wang, a partner at Vdoor Law Firm in Beijing, had arrived in Taiwan on Wednesday “seeking protection from Taiwanese authorities”. ChinaAid said Wang was a lawyer for detained leaders of Zion Church, one of China’s unregistered churches that some Christians choose to worship at instead of state-sanctioned ones regulated by the government. “Wang and her family left China because of concerns about increasing government pressure related to her legal work and representation of detained Beijing Zion Church leaders,” ChinaAid said on Thursday, citing information it had obtained and reporting by the Associated Press news agency. Taiwan’s Mainland Affairs Council issued a brief statement on Friday in response to media reports about a “Chinese lawyer seeking assistance in Taiwan”. It said the government has provided a “Chinese national transferring through a Taiwanese airport” with “temporary accommodation on humanitarian grounds and is following up on the matter”. Members of the Zion Church, including the founder Ezra Jin, were detained in October on “suspicion of the illegal use of information networks”. China released Jin, also known by his Chinese name Mingri, in July after US President Donald Trump raised his case with Xi Jinping. Photo: X. Eight of the Zion Church members detained in October are still being held, ChinaAid said. China’s ruling Communist Party has historically regarded organised religion with suspicion, and under Xi has tightened scrutiny of unofficial groups. Authorities have been cracking down on unregistered churches in recent months.
body.zh: 台湾周五表示，已为一名中国公民提供“临时住所”，此前一个人权组织报道称，一名代表北京地下教会被拘留领导人的律师已逃往台湾。王露丝.照片：王露丝。台湾最高的中国政策机构没有透露此人的身份，但对华援助协会表示，北京Vdoor律师事务所合伙人王露丝已于周三抵达台湾“寻求台湾当局的保护”。对华援助协会表示，王是锡安教会被拘留领导人的律师，锡安教会是中国未注册的教会之一，一些基督徒选择在该教会做礼拜，而不是政府监管的国家认可的教会。对华援助协会周四援引其获得的信息和美联社的报道称，“王和她的家人离开中国是因为担心政府在她的法律工作和代表被拘留的北京锡安教会领袖方面施加的压力越来越大。”台湾陆委会周五发表简短声明，回应媒体有关“中国律师在台寻求援助”的报道。声明称，政府已“出于人道主义理由为一名通过台湾机场转机的中国公民提供临时住宿，并正在跟进此事”。锡安教会成员，包括创始人Ezra Jin，于10月因“涉嫌非法利用信息网络”被拘留。在美国总统唐纳德·特朗普向习近平提出此事后，中国于 7 月释放了金明日。对华援助协会表示，10 月份被拘留的 8 名锡安教会成员仍被关押。中国执政的共产党历来对有组织的宗教持怀疑态度，在习近平的领导下，加强了对非官方团体的审查。近几个月来，当局一直在打击未注册的教堂。

reflection.en: The news of Ruth Wang, a lawyer who represented an underground church and has fled China seeking protection, highlights the courage of those who advocate for religious freedom. Her actions echo the biblical call to speak for the voiceless and defend the rights of the oppressed, even at great personal risk. May her pursuit of safety find peace and her...
reflection.zh: 王瑞德律师曾代理地下教会，现已逃离中国寻求庇护，这一消息凸显了那些倡导宗教自由者的勇气。她的行为呼应了圣经中为无声者发声、为受压迫者辩护的呼召，即使这会带来巨大的个人风险。愿她寻求安全的过程能获得平安，她的倡导能激励他人。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Jockey Club suspends highly anticipated mainland race, citing new risk assessment from Chinese authorities
title.zh: 赛马会因中国当局新风险评估暂停备受期待的内地赛事

summary.en: The Hong Kong Jockey Club (HKJC) has suspended a highly anticipated horse racing event scheduled for mainland China, citing a new risk assessment from Chinese authorities. The event, planned for the HKJC Conghua Racecourse in Guangzhou, was intended to be the club's first racecourse on the Chinese mainland.
summary.zh: 香港赛马会（HKJC）已暂停一项原定在中国内地举行的备受期待的赛马赛事，理由是中国当局的一项新风险评估。该赛事原定在香港赛马会从化马场举行，这将是该马会在中国内地的首个赛马场。

body.en: The Hong Kong Jockey Club (HKJC) has suspended a highly anticipated horse racing event due to be held in mainland China, citing a new risk assessment from mainland authorities. HKJC Conghua Racecourse. Photo: HKJC. Following its annual general meeting, the HKJC said in a statement on Wednesday that the scheduled race meeting would be postponed to an unspecified date. In November last year, HKJC CEO Winfried Engelbrecht-Bresges said in an interview that the club would stage a world-class horse racing event at its Conghua Racecourse in Guangzhou – the club’s first racecourse in the Chinese mainland. The meeting had been scheduled for October 31, and was expected to feature five to six races. Engelbrecht-Bresges said the inaugural meeting would only be attended by officials and invited guests. “The second meeting, which will be at the end of November, will be the first real launch for everyone,” Engelbrecht-Bresges added. “It will be the launch of world-class racing in mainland China.” People witness the exhibition race day in the Conghua Racecourse in March, 2019. Photo: HKJC. According to the HKJC statement, the club “very recently received [the] latest risk assessment from the relevant Mainland departments.” “Following discussions between both parties,” the statement read, “it was agreed that we will continue to work closely together to devise appropriate mitigation measures.” It added that the HKJC has long been working with mainland Chinese authorities to fulfil “all necessary statutory and procedural requirements” for the event. Surprise cancellation Local media reported that the cancellation came as a shock to HKJC members. The Conghua Racecourse was first opened in 2018. In March 2019, the HKJC held an exhibition race day, which saw Hong Kong horses and jockeys compete in the mainland for the first time. VIPs included Hong Kong’s then-chief executive Carrie Lam, then-director of the Hong Kong and Macao Affairs Office Zhang Xiaoming, and then-governor of Guangdong Ma Xingrui. Carrie Lam, then-chief executive of Hong Kong, attends the exhibition race day of Conghua Racecourse in March 2019 and delivers a speech. Photo: HKJC. The Jockey Club, founded in 1884, holds a government-granted monopoly on betting in horseracing and football in Hong Kong. In April this year, the Hong Kong government announced it would suspend plans to legalise basketball betting, citing concerns about the rapid growth of prediction markets.
body.zh: 香港赛马会（HKJC）以内地当局的新风险评估为由，暂停了原定在中国内地举行的备受期待的赛马赛事。香港赛马会从化马场。照片：香港赛马会。香港赛马会在年度股东大会结束后于周三发表声明称，原定的赛马大会将推迟至具体日期。去年11月，马会行政总裁温弗里德在接受采访时表示，马会将在广州从化马场举办世界级赛马赛事，这是马会在中国内地的首个马场。会议原定于 10 月 31 日举行，预计将进行五到六场比赛。恩格尔布雷希特-布雷热表示，首次会议将只有官员和受邀嘉宾参加。 “第二次会议将于 11 月底举行，这将是每个人的第一次真正的启动，”Engelbrecht-Bresges 补充道。 “这将是世界级赛车运动在中国大陆的启动。” 2019年3月，人们在从化马场见证表演赛日。照片：香港赛马会。根据香港赛马会的声明，马会“最近收到了内地有关部门的最新风险评估”。声明中写道：“经过双方讨论，我们同意我们将继续密切合作，制定适当的缓解措施。”它补充说，香港赛马会长期以来一直与中国内地当局合作，以满足赛事的“所有必要的法定和程序要求”。意外取消 当地媒体报道称，取消令马会会员感到震惊。从化马场于2018年首次启用。2019年3月，香港赛马会举办表演赛日，香港马匹和骑师首次在内地比赛。贵宾包括时任香港特首林郑月娥、时任港澳事务办公室主任张晓明、时任广东省省长马兴瑞。 2019年3月，时任香港特首林郑月娥出席从化马场表演赛日并致辞。照片：香港赛马会。赛马会成立于1884年，拥有政府授予的香港赛马和足球博彩垄断权。今年4月，香港政府宣布将暂停篮球博彩合法化计划，理由是对预测市场快速增长的担忧。

reflection.en: The Hong Kong Jockey Club's decision to postpone its mainland race meeting, based on a new risk assessment from Chinese authorities, underscores the unpredictable nature of large-scale projects. It is a reminder that even well-laid plans must ultimately be committed to a higher wisdom and providence, acknowledging that outcomes are not solely within human...
reflection.zh: 香港赛马会因中国当局的一项新风险评估而决定推迟其内地赛事，这凸显了大型项目不可预测的性质。这提醒我们，即使是精心策划的计划，最终也必须托付于更高的智慧和天意，并认识到结果并非完全在人类的掌控之中。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: Hong Kong to consider historic grade status for popular Kennedy Town seaside photo spot
title.zh: 香港考虑将受欢迎的肯尼迪城海滨拍照点列为历史遗迹

summary.en: Hong Kong is considering granting historic grade status to a picturesque seaside spot along the Kennedy Town waterfront, which has become very popular with mainland tourists. The seawall in New Praya, Kennedy Town, is being considered for Grade 2 status by the Antiquities Advisory Board, recognizing its over a century...
summary.zh: 香港正考虑将位于肯尼迪城海滨的一个风景如画的地点列为历史遗迹，该地点已成为内地游客的热门景点。位于肯尼迪城新海旁的海堤，正被考虑授予二级历史建筑地位，并由古物咨询委员会审议，该海堤拥有超过一个世纪的历史。

body.en: Hong Kong is considering granting historic grade status to a picturesque seaside spot along the Kennedy Town waterfront that has surged in popularity among mainland tourists. People line up to take a photo outside a coffee shop near the Kennedy Town Praya, on August 15, 2023. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. According to a memorandum from the Antiquities and Monuments Office, the seawall in New Praya, Kennedy Town, is being considered for Grade 2 status. The Antiquities Advisory Board will meet to discuss the matter on Thursday next week. The seawall, which is not visible from the street, boasts over a century of history. Hong Kong’s historic buildings are classified into three grades, with Grade 1 denoting “buildings of outstanding merit, which every effort should be made to preserve if possible.” Buildings “of special merit” are awarded Grade 2 status, meaning “efforts should be made to selectively preserve” them. People outside a coffee shop near the Kennedy Town Praya, in September 2023. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. According to the document, the Antiquities and Monuments Office will upload its heritage appraisal of the site for a one-month public consultation. ‘Check-in’ culture A quiet neighbourhood on the western end of Hong Kong Island, Kennedy Town has found fame on mainland Chinese social media platform Xiaohongshu in recent years. Among the “check-in spots” promoted by mainland Chinese tourists on the platform is a street sign fronting the sea that reads “New Praya, Kennedy Town.” Tourists can often be found lining up to take photos with the sign. A branch of Japanese coffee chain % Arabica, also beloved by Xiaohongshu users, stands just beside the famous sign. Proposed boardwalk for Kennedy Town’s New Praya waterfront. Photo: Harbourfront Commission. Authorities are also considering building a detached boardwalk along the New Praya waterfront to “enhance visitors’ experience” while preserving the view for social media users. The proposed development will require “small-scale reclamation,” according to development chief Bernadette Linn. Last year, Hong Kong’s legislature passed a bill making it easier for the government to reclaim more land in Victoria Harbour , doing away with a rule introduced in the 1990s requiring an “overriding public need” to be established before reclamation projects could go forward. A month after its passing, Linn warned about “soft resistance” against reclamation projects. Soon thereafter, the Society for the Protection of the Harbour, which for decades advocated to protect the harbour’s surviving waters, unanimously voted to disband .
body.zh: 香港正在考虑授予坚尼地城海滨一处风景如画的海滨景点历史等级地位，该景点在内地游客中人气飙升。 2023 年 8 月 15 日，人们在坚尼地城海旁附近的一家咖啡店外排队拍照。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。根据古物古迹办事处的备忘录，坚尼地城新海旁的海堤正在考虑评定为二级。古物咨询委员会将于下周四开会讨论此事。从街上看不到的海堤拥有一个多世纪的历史。香港的历史建筑分为三级，一级表示“具有杰出价值的建筑物，应尽力保存”。 “具有特殊价值”的建筑被授予二级地位，这意味着“应努力有选择地保护”它们。 2023 年 9 月，坚尼地城海旁附近一家咖啡店外的人们。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。根据该文件，古物古迹办事处将上传该遗址的文物鉴定结果，进行为期一个月的公众咨询。 “打卡”文化 坚尼地城是香港岛西端的一个安静街区，近年来在中国大陆社交媒体平台小红书上名声大噪。中国大陆游客在该平台上宣传的“打卡点”中有一个面向大海的路牌，上面写着“坚尼地城新海旁”。经常可以看到游客排队与这个标志拍照。日本咖啡连锁店%Arabica的一家分店就位于著名招牌旁边，也是小红书用户喜爱的品牌。坚尼地城新海傍海滨的拟议木板路。照片：海滨委员会。当局还在考虑沿着新海旁海滨修建一条独立的木板路，以“增强游客的体验”，同时保留社交媒体用户的视野。开发负责人伯纳黛特·林恩 (Bernadette Linn) 表示，拟议的开发项目将需要“小规模填海”。去年，香港立法机关通过了一项法案，使政府更容易在维多利亚港填海造地，废除了 20 世纪 90 年代引入的一项规定，即在填海项目进行之前必须先确定“压倒性的公众需求”。该法案通过一个月后，林恩对填海项目提出了“软阻力”警告。此后不久，几十年来一直主张保护港口幸存水域的港口保护协会一致投票解散。

reflection.en: This seaside spot in Kennedy Town, with over a century of history, is now a popular destination for photos. It reminds us that all things have their season, as Ecclesiastes says. There is a time to build and a time to appreciate, a time for new popularity and a time for preserving the old.
reflection.zh: 肯尼迪城这个拥有百年历史的海滨景点，如今已成为热门的拍照打卡地。这提醒我们，凡事都有定时，正如传道书所说。有盖造的时候，也有拆毁的时候；有新事物的兴起，也有旧事物的保存。

verse.textEn: There is a time for everything, and a season for every activity under the heavens.
verse.textZh: 凡事都有定期，天下万务都有定时。

title.en: Hong Kong pro-democracy activist Joshua Wong pleads guilty in second national security case
title.zh: 香港民主派活动人士黄之锋承认在第二起国安案中认罪

summary.en: Joshua Wong, a prominent pro-democracy activist in Hong Kong, pleaded guilty on Wednesday to charges under the national security law, specifically conspiring to seek foreign sanctions against China. The charge carries a maximum penalty of life imprisonment.
summary.zh: 香港一位著名的民主派活动人士黄之锋周三承认触犯国安法，罪名是共谋寻求外国制裁中国，该罪名最高可判处无期徒刑。

body.en: Wong, 29, is accused of urging foreign powers to impose sanctions, blockades and other hostile measures against China Joshua Wong , one of Hong Kong’s most prominent pro-democracy activists, pleaded guilty on Wednesday to conspiring to seek foreign sanctions against Hong Kong and China, a national security charge that carries a maximum life sentence. Prosecutors have accused Wong, 29, of working with the exiled Hong Kong activist Nathan Law to urge foreign powers to impose sanctions, blockades or other hostile measures against China. Continue reading...
body.zh: 29 岁的黄之锋被指控敦促外国势力对中国实施制裁、封锁和其他敌对措施。香港最著名的民主活动人士之一黄之锋周三承认密谋寻求外国对香港和中国实施制裁，这一国家安全指控最高可判处无期徒刑。检察官指控 29 岁的黄与流亡香港活动人士罗冠聪合作，敦促外国势力对中国实施制裁、封锁或其他敌对措施。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Joshua Wong, a young activist known for his role in Hong Kong's democracy movement, has pleaded guilty to charges under the national security law. This situation brings to the fore the difficult tension between civic obedience and deeply held convictions. The apostles' unwavering stance, 'We must obey God rather than human beings,' offers a timeless...
reflection.zh: 香港一位以其在民主运动中角色而闻名的年轻活动人士黄之锋，已承认触犯国安法。这一局面凸显了公民服从与内心深处信念之间的艰难张力。使徒们坚定的立场——“顺从神，过于顺从人”——为这种良心冲突提供了永恒的视角。

verse.textEn: We must obey God rather than human beings!
verse.textZh: 顺从神，不顺从人，是应当的。

title.en: Shein shares slide on fast-fashion retailer’s stock market debut
title.zh: Shein股票上市首日下跌，快时尚零售商估值缩水

summary.en: Shares of the fast-fashion brand Shein fell as much as 10% on their debut on the Hong Kong stock exchange. The company, founded in China and now headquartered in Singapore, was valued at just over $26 billion, a significant drop from its previous valuation of nearly $100 billion.
summary.zh: 快时尚品牌Shein在香港证券交易所上市首日股价下跌高达10%。这家中国创立、现总部设在新加坡的公司，估值略高于260亿美元，远低于其此前近1000亿美元的估值。

body.en: Hong Kong flotation at $26bn by firm once valued at $100bn follows failure to list in US and UK Shares in the fast-fashion brand Shein slumped by as much as 10% as the China-founded company made its long-anticipated trading debut on the Hong Kong stock exchange. The Singapore-headquartered company, once valued at almost $100bn (£74bn), went public on Tuesday pricing shares at HK$48.56, valuing the business at just over $26bn. Continue reading...
body.zh: 曾估值 1000 亿美元的公司在香港发行 260 亿美元，此前该公司未能在美国和英国上市。快时尚品牌 Shein 在香港证券交易所首次上市后，其股价下跌了 10%。这家总部位于新加坡的公司一度估值近 1000 亿美元（740 亿英镑），周二上市，股价为 48.56 港元，业务估值略高于 260 亿美元。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The dramatic drop in Shein's valuation on its Hong Kong stock market debut, from nearly $100 billion to just over $26 billion, serves as a potent reminder of the volatile nature of commerce. Proverbs 16:3 encourages us to commit our endeavors to Yahweh, trusting that He will establish our plans, a wisdom that transcends market highs and lows.
reflection.zh: Shein在香港股市上市首日估值从近1000亿美元暴跌至略高于260亿美元，这有力地提醒我们商业的波动性。箴言16:3鼓励我们将所做的事交托给雅伟，信靠祂必成就我们的计划，这智慧超越了市场的起伏。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: The London stock market dodged a bullet with Shein | Nils Pratley
title.zh: 希音避开伦敦股市，转投香港上市

summary.en: Shein, the Chinese fast-fashion giant, has decided to list its shares in Hong Kong instead of London, despite political efforts in the UK to attract the company. The company's valuation has also been reduced, and questions remain about its business model.
summary.zh: 这家中国快时尚巨头希音（Shein）已决定在香港上市，而非伦敦，尽管英国政界曾努力吸引该公司。该公司的估值也有所缩水，其商业模式仍存疑问。

body.en: China’s fashion giant will list in Hong Kong with a shrunken price tag – and big questions over its business model In a parallel world, we might now be preparing for the arrival on the London stock market of Shein, the giant Chinese-founded fast-fashion retailer. Or it could have happened already. The possibility of a London flotation was a running story during 2024 and into last year as politicians from both main parties engaged in behind-the-scenes wooing. Shein was seen as a shot of tech adrenalin for a listless local listings scene, and an opportunity to advertise the UK’s openness to international capital. Continue reading...
body.zh: 中国时尚巨头将以更低的价格在香港上市——其商业模式面临重大疑问在另一个平行世界中，我们现在可能正在为中国创办的大型快时尚零售商 Shein 登陆伦敦股市做准备。或者它可能已经发生了。 2024 年和去年，随着两个主要政党的政治家都在幕后拉拢，在伦敦上市的可能性一直是一个热门话题。 Shein 被视为为当地无精打采的上市场景注入一剂科技肾上腺素，也是宣传英国对国际资本开放的机会。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The news of Shein's decision to list in Hong Kong, rather than London, involves complex business and political considerations. Proverbs 16:3 reminds us to commit our endeavors to Yahweh, trusting that He will establish our plans. This principle encourages seeking divine guidance in all our work, whether personal or corporate, ensuring our efforts align with...
reflection.zh: 希音公司决定在香港上市而非伦敦的消息，涉及复杂的商业和政治考量。箴言16:3提醒我们，要将所做的一切事交托给雅伟，信靠祂，祂就必成就我们所谋划的。这一原则鼓励我们在所有工作中，无论是个人的还是企业的，都寻求神的指引，确保我们的努力与祂的旨意相符。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: The Guardian view on the Tiananmen vigil convictions: Hong Kong too has been silenced. Others should speak out | Editorial
title.zh: 《卫报》评论：天安门集会定罪，香港亦被噤声。他人应发声

summary.en: Two activists who organized commemorations of the bloody crackdown on China’s 1989 pro-democracy protests now face jail. Remembering is not a crime. For decades, Hong Kong mourned when the mainland could not. Its huge annual Tiananmen vigil kept alive the memory of the 1989 pro-reform protests in Beijing, and of the...
summary.zh: 两名组织纪念中国1989年镇压民主抗议活动的活动家现在面临牢狱之灾。铭记并非罪行。几十年来，当中国大陆无法哀悼时，香港却在哀悼。香港每年举办的大型天安门纪念活动，让人们记住了1989年北京的改革抗议活动以及镇压它们的屠杀。与澳门一起，香港是中国唯一能够公开纪念这一周年并保存真相的地方。但2019年香港起义遭到镇压，粉碎...

body.en: Two activists who organised commemorations of the bloody crackdown on China’s 1989 pro-democracy protests now face jail. Remembering is not a crime For decades, Hong Kong mourned when the mainland could not. Its huge annual Tiananmen vigil kept alive the memory of the 1989 pro-reform protests in Beijing, and of the massacre that suppressed them. Along with Macau, it was the only place in China where the anniversary could be publicly marked and the truth preserved. But the crackdown on the 2019 uprising in Hong Kong has crushed the freedoms that the region once enjoyed. That year’s vigil was the last. On Friday, two leaders of the Hong Kong Alliance, which organised the commemoration, were convicted of incitement to subversion under the draconian national security law. Lee Cheuk-yan, 69, and Chow Hang-tung, 41, face up to 10 years in jail. Do you have an opinion on the issues raised in this article? If you would like to submit a response of up to 300 words by email to be considered for publication in our letters section, please click here . Continue reading...
body.zh: 两名组织纪念中国 1989 年民主抗议活动血腥镇压的活动人士现在面临牢狱之灾。铭记不是犯罪 几十年来，香港一直在哀悼，而大陆却无法铭记。一年一度的天安门守夜活动让人们牢牢记住了1989年北京支持改革的抗议活动以及镇压抗议活动的大屠杀。它与澳门一样，是中国唯一可以公开纪念这一周年并保存真相的地方。但2019年香港起义的镇压摧毁了该地区曾经享有的自由。那一年的守夜活动是最后一次。周五，组织这次纪念活动的香港联盟的两名领导人根据严厉的国家安全法被判犯有煽动颠覆罪。 69 岁的李卓人和 41 岁的周恒东将面临最高 10 年的监禁。您对本文提出的问题有什么看法吗？如果您想通过电子邮件提交最多 300 字的回复，以便考虑在我们的信件部分发布，请单击此处。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The conviction of Hong Kong activists for organizing Tiananmen Square commemorations underscores a profound tension between state authority and the human impulse to remember. When laws compel silence on historical truths, the call to obey God rather than human authorities becomes a vital principle for conscience.
reflection.zh: 香港活动家因组织纪念天安门事件而被定罪，这凸显了国家权威与人类记忆冲动之间深刻的紧张关系。当法律强制对历史真相保持沉默时，“宁可事奉雅伟，不愿事奉人”的原则就成为良知的关键。

verse.textEn: We must obey God rather than human beings!
verse.textZh: 顺从神，不顺从人，是应当的。

title.en: Plea to give Thames seals space for everyone's safety
title.zh: 呼吁给伦敦的泰晤士河海豹留出空间，以确保所有人的安全

summary.en: A charity is urging the public to maintain distance from seals spotted along the River Thames, warning that close contact can be dangerous for both the animals and people due to potential bites and zoonotic diseases. Increased seal sightings further up the river necessitate this caution.
summary.zh: 一个慈善机构敦促公众与在泰晤士河沿岸发现的海豹保持距离，并警告说，由于可能发生的咬伤和人畜共患疾病，近距离接触可能对动物和人类都构成危险。河道上游海豹目击事件的增加，使得这种谨慎尤为必要。

body.en:
Marmalade the harbour seal was a familiar visitor to the River Thames, often popping up at Greenwich and Rotherhithe in south-east London.

However, as the number of seal sightings along the river increases, charity Thames Seal Watch has urged members of the public to give the animals space.

Despite looking cute, Emma Kelly from the charity says: "They can bite and they carry zoonotic diseases which are not very pleasant if you were to suffer a bite.

She says getting close to the animals can cause them distress and stress, which could lead to their death.

The charity says more and more of the seals are travelling further up the river, with one spotted as far west as Windsor.

It is thought there are about 3,500 seals living in the Thames and that they mostly stay around the estuary, east of London.

Marmalade was considered rare because there are only 500 harbour seals living in the river, compared with about 3,000 of the more common grey seals.

Gareth Richards from UK Seal Alliance says "seals are very transient, and will basically go to where there is good fish stocks".

Because they are being spotted more frequently, Richards says he would like to see further protection of the animals in law.

Neither grey nor harbour seals are protected from intentional or reckless disturbance under the Wildlife and Countryside Act 1981.

In May, UK Seal Alliance launched its Give Seals Space , external campaign, calling on the government to reconsider previous recommendations and provide the two species "with the legal protection they deserve".

The campaign warns that they are highly sensitive to disturbance from the public, animals and drones.

It states these can have long-lasting consequences to the animals' health and that it can lead to pup abandonment, wasted energy from staying alert and injuries from panic fleeing.

The Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs (Defra) says: "We have a suite of legislative protections in place which make it an offence to take, injure, capture or kill a seal."

Some volunteers from Thames Seal Watch, including Kelly, gathered at one of her favourite spots near the University of Greenwich for a short memorial.

Flowers were thrown into the river and a small plaque in her memory was erected.

"We created a community around Marmalade where there was lots of us to keep an eye on her and ensure she stayed safe."

Marmalade also helped attract a number of new volunteers to the charity, and all those at the memorial made a commitment that they would continue to help London's wildlife in the best way they can.

body.zh: 斑海豹果酱是泰晤士河上常见的游客，经常出现在伦敦东南部的格林威治和罗瑟海斯。 然而，随着沿河看到海豹数量的增加，慈善机构泰晤士海豹观察组织敦促公众给这些动物留出空间。 尽管看起来很可爱，但该慈善机构的艾玛·凯利说：“它们会咬人，而且携带人畜共患疾病，如果你被咬了，你会感到不太舒服。 她说，接近这些动物会给它们带来痛苦和压力，这可能会导致它们死亡。 该慈善机构表示，越来越多的海豹正沿着河流向上游移动，其中一只被发现最西边的温莎。 据信泰晤士河里生活着大约 3,500 只海豹，它们大多生活在伦敦东部的河口附近。 果酱之所以被认为是稀有的，是因为河里只有 500 只斑海豹，而较常见的灰海豹约有 3,000 只。 英国海豹联盟的加雷斯·理查兹表示，“海豹的短暂性非常强，基本上会去有优质鱼类资源的地方”。 由于它们被发现的频率越来越高，理查兹说他希望看到法律对这些动物进行进一步的保护。 根据 1981 年《野生动物和乡村法案》，灰海豹和斑海豹均不受故意或鲁莽骚扰的保护。 今年五月，英国海豹联盟发起了“给予海豹空间”的外部活动，呼吁政府重新考虑之前的建议，并为这两个物种提供“它们应有的法律保护”。 该活动警告说，他们对公众、动物和无人机的干扰高度敏感。 报告指出，这些可能会对动物的健康产生长期影响，并可能导致幼崽被遗弃、因保持警觉而浪费能量以及因恐慌逃跑而受伤。 英国环境、食品和农村事务部（Defra）表示：“我们制定了一套立法保护措施，将捕获、伤害、捕获或杀死海豹定为犯罪行为。” 包括凯利在内的泰晤士海豹观察组织的一些志愿者聚集在格林威治大学附近她最喜欢的地点之一，举行了简短的纪念活动。 人们向河里扔了鲜花，并竖立了一块纪念她的小牌匾。 “我们在 Marmalade 周围创建了一个社区，那里有很多人来关注她并确保她的安全。” 果酱还帮助吸引了许多新的志愿者加入该慈善机构，所有参加纪念活动的人都承诺将继续尽其所能帮助伦敦的野生动物。 通过 Sounds 收听 BBC 伦敦广播电台的精彩内容，并在 Facebook、external、X、external 和 Instagram、external 上关注 BBC London。将您的故事想法发送至外部 hello.bbclondon@bbc.co.uk

reflection.en: As more seals venture into the Thames, the charity Thames Seal Watch reminds us that even familiar wildlife requires respect and distance for mutual safety. This echoes the wisdom that seeking knowledge and understanding is essential for navigating our interactions with the natural world and each other.
reflection.zh: 随着越来越多的海豹进入泰晤士河，泰晤士海豹观察组织提醒我们，即使是熟悉的野生动物也需要尊重和距离，以确保双方的安全。这呼应了这样一种智慧：寻求知识和理解对于我们与自然界以及彼此的互动至关重要。

verse.textEn: The heart of the discerning acquires knowledge, for the ears of the wise seek it out.
verse.textZh: 聪明人的心得知识；智慧人的耳求知识。

title.en: Manx space group urges election candidates to back treaty
title.zh: 马恩岛太空组织敦促大选候选人支持条约

summary.en: The Isle of Man Mars Society is urging politicians to sign an international space exploration agreement, specifically the Artemis Accords, as a low-risk way to demonstrate ambition in space projects.
summary.zh: 马恩岛火星协会正敦促政界人士签署一项国际太空探索协议，特别是《阿尔忒弥斯协定》，以此作为展示其太空项目雄心的低风险方式。

body.en:
Candidates standing in the Isle of Man's general election have been sent letters asking them to back the island signing up to an international space treaty.

The Manx chapter of the Mars Society wants the island to become a signatory to the Artemis Accords, the framework for peaceful, transparent space exploration now backed by more than 70 nations, including the UK as a founding member.

The accords, launched by Nasa in 2020, are non-binding and require no parliamentary ratification, membership fee or financial contribution to sign.

Chapter leader Stuart Mullan said it was a "low-risk, high-visibility way" for the island to show ambition around space projects.

"Signing the Artemis Accords costs nothing and commits us to nothing beyond principles we already stand for," said Mullan.

"Joining the accords would put us on the map internationally and gives a real boost to the case for developing more STEM [science, technology, engineering, and mathematics] projects on the island."

The Isle of Man's Space Registry handles satellite filings for some major space operators.

"Nobody is suggesting the Isle of Man starts launching rockets," Mullan continued.

"All we ask is that candidates consider promoting the Isle of Man as an attractive base for STEM companies and businesses, the kind that bring skilled, well-paid jobs the Island badly needs right now.

"The space sector globally needs the same things the Island already provides for aircraft and shipping.

"Finance, legal services, tax expertise, insurance, and regulatory know-how. It would be a strange decision not to look seriously at whether the Isle of Man can capture a share of an industry that's growing this fast. We think it can."

Elon Musk's Space X company operates a satellite ground station on the island while satellite giants including SES, Inmarsat, Avanti and Telesat have all registered spacecraft through the Isle of Man's filing system.

Read more stories from the Isle of Man on the BBC, watch BBC North West Tonight on BBC iPlayer and follow BBC Isle of Man on Facebook , external and X , external .
body.zh: 参加马恩岛大选的候选人已收到信件，要求他们支持该岛签署国际太空条约。 火星协会的马恩岛分会希望该岛成为《阿耳忒弥斯协议》的签署国，该协议是和平、透明的太空探索框架，目前得到 70 多个国家的支持，其中包括作为创始成员的英国。 这些协议由美国宇航局 (NASA) 于 2020 年发起，不具有约束力，无需议会批准、无需缴纳会员费或捐款即可签署。 分会负责人斯图尔特·穆兰表示，这是该岛展示太空项目雄心的一种“低风险、高知名度的方式”。 穆兰说：“签署《阿耳忒弥斯协议》不需要任何成本，除了我们已经代表的原则之外，我们没有任何承诺。” “加入这些协议将使我们在国际上享有盛誉，并真正推动在岛上开发更多 STEM（科学、技术、工程和数学）项目。” 马恩岛太空登记处为一些主要太空运营商处理卫星备案。 “没有人建议马恩岛开始发射火箭，”穆兰继续说道。 “我们所要求的只是候选人考虑将马恩岛打造成对 STEM 公司和企业具有吸引力的基地，这种基地可以为该岛带来目前急需的技术精湛、高薪工作。 “全球航天部门需要的东西与岛上已经为飞机和航运提供的东西相同。 “金融、法律服务、税务专业知识、保险和监管知识。如果不认真考虑马恩岛是否能够在如此快速增长的行业中分得一杯羹，那将是一个奇怪的决定。我们认为它可以。” 埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 的 Space X 公司在岛上运营着一个卫星地面站，而包括 SES、Inmarsat、Avanti 和 Telesat 在内的卫星巨头都通过马恩岛的备案系统注册了航天器。 在 BBC 上阅读更多来自马恩岛的故事，在 BBC iPlayer 上观看 BBC 西北今晚节目，并在 Facebook、external 和 X, external 上关注 BBC Isle of Man。

reflection.en: As the Isle of Man considers signing the Artemis Accords, it looks outward to the stars. This echoes the ancient wonder of contemplating humanity's place in the vast universe, a space where Yahweh's presence is profoundly felt. Even as we reach for the cosmos, we are reminded of our unique value and significance in the grand design.
reflection.zh: 当马恩岛考虑签署《阿尔忒弥斯协定》时，他们的目光投向了星辰大海。这呼应了古人对人类在浩瀚宇宙中地位的惊叹，而雅伟的临在感在此空间中尤为强烈。即使我们向宇宙伸出双手，我们也被提醒在我们宏伟的设计中，我们独特的价值和意义。

verse.textEn: What is mankind that you are mindful of them, human beings that you care for them?
verse.textZh: 人算什么，你竟顾念他？

title.en: Ancient cave art discovery suggests first known humans in Ireland walked over from Wales
title.zh: 古代洞穴艺术发现表明爱尔兰最早的人类可能来自威尔士

summary.en: Researchers believe that the first humans in Ireland, thousands of years ago, likely migrated from Wales via a land bridge that existed during the last Ice Age. This theory is supported by the discovery of ancient cave art at eight sites in southwest Ireland.
summary.zh: 研究人员认为，数千年前最早踏足爱尔兰的人类很可能通过冰河时期存在的陆桥从威尔士迁徙而来。这一理论得到了在爱尔兰西南部八个地点发现的古代洞穴艺术的支持。

body.en:
Researchers believe the first known humans to set foot on Ireland thousands of years ago were most likely from Wales, following the "exciting" discovery of ancient cave art.

During the most recent Ice Age, when much of the British Isles were beneath a vast continental glacier, the depleted sea levels opened a "lost land bridge" between modern-day Pembrokeshire and the south-east tip of Ireland, around Rosslare.

According to rock expert Dr George Nash, from Liverpool University, the opportunities presented by this pathway would have been too good for hunter gatherers to ignore.

Now, alongside an international team of experts, Nash has located eight cave sites in south-west Ireland featuring rock art dating back from at least 15,000 years ago, around 5,000 years before the previous oldest example of humans in Ireland.

Nash, who coordinated the Lost Land Bridge Project, said there would have been a forested and grassland plateau around 46 miles (76 km) coast-to-coast.

With summertime temperatures typically -10°C to -20°C, Nash said the pathway would have supported wild horses, mammoth, bison, reindeer and other large herbivores, which fed off the hardy sedges, mosses and lichens growing through the fertile, but near-frozen soil.

Nash said he had always believed - from what he had gleaned throughout his career about human movement during the period - that it was inconceivable that people would not have utilised the opportunity the pathway presented.

This led him to assemble his multi-disciplinary team of experts from University College Dublin and the University of Adelaide, along with academics from Dubai, Wales and Portugal.

"Up until now the earliest evidence archaeologists had found - through accidental discovery - was from around 10,500 years ago, but everyone - not just me - knew that simply couldn't have been correct.

"We just weren't looking hard enough, and not in the right places. The principle we worked on was 'absence of proof isn't proof of absence'."

"With the help of caving specialist Shane Diffily and digital mapping consultant Darren Lee, we were able to fill a computer algorithm with everything we knew about the characteristics of cave dwellings in south Wales and set it to work searching for similar sites in Ireland, without us trudging blindly around the countryside, hoping to bump into something which looked promising."

What their computer model spat out was 28 potential caves in south-west Ireland which the team investigated.

Eight of them were found to have cave art which they believe dates from at least 15,000 years ago and possibly much earlier, and around 5,000 years before the previous oldest example of humans in Ireland.

The team are currently unwilling to be more precise about the location of the caves, for fear...
body.zh: 研究人员认为，在“令人兴奋”的古代洞穴艺术发现之后，数千年前踏上爱尔兰的第一批已知人类很可能来自威尔士。 在最近的冰河时代，当时不列颠群岛的大部分地区都位于巨大的大陆冰川之下，海平面的枯竭在现代彭布罗克郡和罗斯莱尔周围的爱尔兰东南端之间打开了一座“失落的陆桥”。 利物浦大学的岩石专家乔治·纳什博士表示，这条道路所提供的机会对于狩猎采集者来说是不容忽视的。 现在，纳什与国际专家团队一起在爱尔兰西南部找到了八个洞穴遗址，其中的岩石艺术至少可以追溯到 15,000 年前，比爱尔兰之前最古老的人类例子大约早 5,000 年。 负责协调“失落大陆桥”项目的纳什表示，从海岸到海岸大约 46 英里（76 公里）处将会有一片森林和草原高原。 纳什表示，夏季气温通常为-10°C至-20°C，这条道路可以支持野马、猛犸象、野牛、驯鹿和其他大型食草动物的生存，这些动物以生长在肥沃但近乎冰冻的土壤中的耐寒莎草、苔藓和地衣为食。 纳什说，从他在整个职业生涯中收集到的有关这一时期人类活动的信息来看，他一直相信，人们不可能不利用这条道路所提供的机会。 这促使他组建了由都柏林大学学院和阿德莱德大学的多学科专家团队以及来自迪拜、威尔士和葡萄牙的学者组成的团队。 “到目前为止，考古学家通过偶然发现发现的最早证据来自大约 10,500 年前，但每个人 - 不仅仅是我 - 都知道这根本不可能是正确的。 “我们只是没有足够努力地寻找，而且没有找对地方。我们遵循的原则是‘没有证据并不等于缺席’。” “在洞穴专家肖恩·迪菲利（Shane Diffily）和数字地图顾问达伦·李（Darren Lee）的帮助下，我们能够用我们所知道的关于南威尔士洞穴民居特征的所有信息填充计算机算法，并使其能够在爱尔兰寻找类似的地点，而无需我们盲目地在乡村中跋涉，希望能碰到一些看起来有希望的东西。” 他们的计算机模型输出的是团队调查的爱尔兰西南部 28 个潜在洞穴。 其中八个被发现拥有洞穴艺术，他们认为这些艺术的历史至少可以追溯到 15,000 年前，甚至可能更早，比爱尔兰之前最古老的人类例子早大约 5,000 年。 该团队目前不愿透露洞穴的更精确位置，因为担心......

reflection.en: The discovery of ancient cave art in Ireland, suggesting migration from Wales across a prehistoric land bridge, offers a tangible link to our distant ancestors. It reminds us that the earth itself holds stories, and careful observation of its features and remnants can reveal profound insights into human history and God's creation.
reflection.zh: 在爱尔兰发现的古代洞穴艺术，暗示着人类曾通过史前陆桥从威尔士迁徙而来，这为我们与遥远的祖先建立了一条具体的联系。它提醒我们，大地本身就蕴藏着故事，通过仔细观察其地貌和遗迹，可以揭示关于人类历史和雅伟创造的深刻见解。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Life uses 4 DNA letters. Scientists just made 8 work
title.zh: 生命使用4个DNA字母。科学家刚刚让8个奏效

summary.en: Researchers at UC San Diego have demonstrated that a key cellular enzyme can accurately read an eight-letter genetic alphabet, doubling the four letters used by all known life on Earth. Detailed imaging revealed that RNA polymerase handles synthetic DNA letters in surprisingly similar ways to natural ones. The finding...
summary.zh: 加州大学圣地亚哥分校的研究人员已经证明，一种关键的细胞酶可以准确地读取一个八个字母的遗传字母表，是地球上所有已知生命所使用的四倍。详细的成像显示，RNA聚合酶处理合成DNA字母的方式与处理天然DNA字母惊人地相似。这一发现使科学家们更接近于构建能够执行全新生物学功能的扩展遗传系统。

body.en: Researchers at UC San Diego have demonstrated that a key cellular enzyme can accurately read an eight-letter genetic alphabet, doubling the four letters used by all known life on Earth. Detailed imaging revealed that RNA polymerase handles synthetic DNA letters in surprisingly similar ways to natural ones. The finding brings scientists closer to building expanded genetic systems that could perform entirely new biological functions.
body.zh: 加州大学圣地亚哥分校的研究人员证明，一种关键的细胞酶可以准确读取八个字母的遗传字母表，使地球上所有已知生命使用的四个字母增加一倍。详细成像显示，RNA 聚合酶处理合成 DNA 字母的方式与天然 DNA 字母惊人地相似。这一发现使科学家们距离构建能够执行全新生物功能的扩展遗传系统又近了一步。

reflection.en: The relentless human drive to explore and understand the building blocks of life has led to a remarkable breakthrough: doubling the genetic alphabet. This expansion of our knowledge, as described in Daniel 12:4, reflects a world where 'knowledge increases.' As we unlock new biological functions, may we do so with wisdom and a deep respect for the intricate...
reflection.zh: 人类探索和理解生命基本构件的不懈驱动力带来了突破性的进展：遗传字母表翻倍。但以理书12:4说“知识增长”，这反映了我们知识的扩展。当我们解锁新的生物功能时，愿我们以智慧和对造物精妙设计的深深敬意来行事。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Quantum oscillations defy expectations in this exotic material
title.zh: 量子振荡在此奇异材料中出乎意料

summary.en: Scientists have observed unusual quantum oscillations in zirconium pentatelluride, a material exhibiting both insulating and conductive properties. Under extreme conditions of near-absolute-zero temperatures and powerful magnetic fields, electrons in this quantum material displayed unexpected behaviors, challenging...
summary.zh: 科学家在五碲化锆（一种同时具有绝缘体和导体特性的材料）中发现了异常的量子振荡现象。在接近绝对零度的低温和强大的磁场条件下，这种量子材料中的电子表现出意想不到的行为，挑战了现有的科学预期。

body.en:
A study published in Nature Communications has revealed an unusual form of quantum oscillation in a three-dimensional topological insulator. The findings show that electrons in zirconium pentatelluride (ZrTe 5 ) can behave in unexpected ways when exposed to temperatures close to absolute zero and extremely powerful magnetic fields.

The research was led by scientists from the University of São Paulo (USP) in Brazil, Los Alamos National Laboratory, the University of Washington, and other U.S. institutions. The team combined electrical transport experiments performed in magnetic fields as strong as 60 tesla and at temperatures near 0.7 kelvin (-272.45 °C) with detailed theoretical calculations.

"This work expands our understanding of electron transport in exotic phases of matter and suggests that topological insulators support the transport of not only electric charge, but also another fundamental degree of freedom: electron spin," says Julio Larrea Jiménez, a professor at USP's Physics Institute (IF) and co-founder and director of the Laboratory for Quantum Matter under Extreme Conditions (LQMEC).

Larrea served as the doctoral advisor of Cauê Kaufmann Ribeiro, the study's first author. Ribeiro carried out a large portion of the experimental work during an internship at the National High Magnetic Field Laboratory in Los Alamos, United States, supported by a FAPESP Research Internship Abroad. While there, he was co-advised by Johanna Palmstrom and Sean Thomas.

Topological insulators have an unusual combination of properties. Their interiors behave as electrical insulators, while their surfaces can conduct electricity. This behavior arises from the topology of their electronic bands, which describes broad features of the quantum structure of electronic states that are protected by crystal symmetries.

ZrTe 5 is especially valuable for studying this type of physics because it sits close to the boundary separating different topological phases. Small changes in temperature, mechanical deformation, chemical composition, or magnetic field can significantly alter its electronic behavior. That sensitivity has made ZrTe 5 an important material for investigating topological phase transitions and relativistic quasiparticles in solids.

When electrons move through a magnetic field, their possible energies no longer form a continuous range. Quantum mechanics restricts them to specific energy values known as Landau levels, named after the Soviet physicist and mathematician Lev Landau (1908-1968).

In very pure metals, these Landau levels can repeatedly pass through the Fermi level, the energy boundary between occupied and unoccupied electronic states. Each crossing can produce an oscillation in electrical resistance. These effects, known...
body.zh: 发表在《自然通讯》上的一项研究揭示了三维拓扑绝缘体中量子振荡的一种不寻常形式。研究结果表明，当暴露于接近绝对零的温度和极其强大的磁场时，五碲化锆 (ZrTe 5 ) 中的电子会以意想不到的方式表现。 这项研究由巴西圣保罗大学 (USP)、洛斯阿拉莫斯国家实验室、华盛顿大学和其他美国机构的科学家领导。该团队将在强至 60 特斯拉的磁场和接近 0.7 开尔文 (-272.45 °C) 的温度下进行的电传输实验与详细的理论计算相结合。 USP 物理研究所 (IF) 教授、极端条件下量子物质实验室 (LQMEC) 联合创始人兼主任 Julio Larrea Jiménez 表示：“这项工作扩展了我们对物质奇异相中电子传输的理解，并表明拓扑绝缘体不仅支持电荷传输，还支持另一个基本自由度：电子自旋。” Larrea 担任该研究第一作者 Cauê Kaufmann Ribeiro 的博士生导师。 Ribeiro 在美国洛斯阿拉莫斯国家高磁场实验室实习期间，在 FAPESP 海外研究实习项目的支持下，完成了大部分实验工作。在那里，他得到了约翰娜·帕姆斯特罗姆和肖恩·托马斯的共同建议。 拓扑绝缘体具有不寻常的特性组合。它们的内部表现为电绝缘体，而它们的表面可以导电。这种行为源于其电子带的拓扑结构，它描述了受晶体对称性保护的电子态量子结构的广泛特征。 ZrTe 5 对于研究此类物理特别有价值，因为它靠近分隔不同拓扑相的边界。温度、机械变形、化学成分或磁场的微小变化都可以显着改变其电子行为。这种敏感性使 ZrTe 5 成为研究固体中拓扑相变和相对论性准粒子的重要材料。 当电子穿过磁场时，它们可能的能量不再形成连续的范围。量子力学将它们限制在称为朗道能级的特定能量值，该能量值以苏联物理学家和数学家列夫·朗道（Lev Landau，1908-1968）的名字命名。 在非常纯的金属中，这些朗道能级可以反复穿过费米能级，费米能级是占据和未占据电子态之间的能量边界。每次交叉都会产生电阻振荡。这些影响，众所周知...

reflection.en: The universe, in its intricate quantum dance, continues to reveal wonders that stretch our understanding. Job 12:7 reminds us that even the smallest creatures and the most complex materials can teach us about the Creator's wisdom. As scientists probe the depths of matter, they are, in a sense, listening to the silent testimony of creation, which declares...
reflection.zh: 宇宙在其精妙的量子之舞中，不断揭示着拓展我们理解力的奇迹。约伯记12:7提醒我们，即使是最微小的生物和最复杂的物质，也能教导我们关于创造主的智慧。科学家们在探索物质深处时，在某种意义上是在倾听受造之物的无声见证，它宣告了雅伟的荣耀和智慧。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Study reveals pupils most at risk of school suspension and what may help them
title.zh: 研究揭示最易被停学的学生以及可能帮助他们的因素

summary.en: New research from The University of Manchester indicates that school suspensions are linked to a complex interplay of socioeconomic disadvantage, special educational needs, peer relationships, and students' overall school experiences. The study analyzed data from over 19,000 secondary school students to identify...
summary.zh: 曼彻斯特大学的一项新研究表明，学校停学与社会经济劣势、特殊教育需求、同伴关系以及学生在校的整体经历等复杂因素相互关联。该研究分析了来自超过19,000名中学生的调查数据，以找出与停学率相关的因素。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

School suspensions are associated with a complex combination of socioeconomic disadvantage, special educational needs, peer relationships and students' experiences of school, according to new research from The University of Manchester.

The study analyzed survey responses from more than 19,000 secondary school students linked to administrative records across Hampshire and the Isle of Wight to examine a wide range of factors associated with whether students were suspended and how often suspensions occurred.

Researchers found that students receiving special educational needs (SEN) support or who had an Education, Health and Care Plan (EHCP) were more than twice as likely to be suspended as students without SEN, while those eligible for free school meals were also at increased risk.

The analysis also identified several factors associated with lower suspension risk, including students feeling that they belonged at school, being satisfied with their academic attainment, having positive relationships with school staff and having stronger emotion regulation skills.

By contrast, higher levels of peer pressure, experiences of bullying and recent substance use were associated with an increased likelihood of suspension.

The findings suggest that suspension should not be viewed solely through the lens of individual student behavior but in the context of the wider circumstances and relationships surrounding young people.

The research used data from the #BeeWell program, a youth well-being measurement program led by The University of Manchester in collaboration with Anna Freud, a children's mental health charity, and the Gregson Family Foundation.

The #BeeWell survey captures young people's well-being alongside factors that can influence it, including school experiences, health behaviors, peer and family relationships and neighborhood characteristics. Survey responses can be linked with administrative data held by participating local authorities, allowing researchers to examine young people's experiences alongside information about suspension and exclusion.

The researchers analyzed data from 19,064 students in Years 8 and 10 across 69 mainstream secondary schools in Hampshire and Southampton during the 2023–24 academic year. Around 6% of students in the study had been suspended at least once during the academic year.
